description.en: Install this dsh plugin to use frontier models like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 with no login, no API key, and no usage cap.
description.zh: 在 dsh 安装此插件即可免登录、免 API Key 使用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 等前沿模型，完全免费不限量。

description.en: AI coding agent for the terminal built on DeepSeek, designed for stable long-running sessions via prefix caching.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek 的终端 AI 编程助手，围绕前缀缓存稳定性设计，可长时间持续运行。

description.en: EverOS is a local-first, Markdown-native memory layer that lets AI agents keep user-owned long-term memory across apps and workflows.
description.zh: EverOS 是一个本地优先、以 Markdown 为原生格式的记忆层，让 AI 智能体在各类应用与工作流之间共享用户自有的长期记忆。

description.en: A visual plugin marketplace inside DeepSeek Harness for browsing, searching, and one-click installing plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内提供可视化插件市场，可浏览、搜索插件并一键安装。

description.en: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI agents with persistent memory, hybrid retrieval, and skill reuse.
description.zh: 为 LLM 与 AI 智能体提供自进化记忆系统，支持持久记忆、混合检索和跨任务技能复用，可节省 35.24% token。

description.en: A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness that supports main bots, bot-to-bot messaging, and group chats.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期运行的机器人团队，支持主机器人、机器人间消息和群聊。

description.en: Self-hosted dashboard to manage AI agents and workspaces, tracking tasks on a board across all devices.
description.zh: 自托管看板，集中管理 AI 智能体与工作区，可通过桌面、手机、浏览器或 API 跟踪任务。

description.en: A context-compression plugin that keeps month-long single sessions with billions of tokens within a small 100K context window.
description.zh: 一个上下文压缩插件，让长达数月的单次会话即便有数十亿 token，也能在 100K 的小上下文窗口内运行。

description.en: Provides a Claude Code style full-screen interactive terminal UI for DSH, featuring a pixel whale top bar, real-time status, streaming thinking, and progress meters.
description.zh: 为DSH提供Claude Code风格的全屏交互终端界面，含像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时状态行与流式思考显示。

description.en: Plugin for dsh to switch Wallpaper Engine wallpapers and adjust visual effects like blur, brightness, border, and liquid glass via sliders.
description.zh: 用于 dsh 切换 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸，并通过滑动条调节模糊、亮度、边框和液态玻璃效果。

description.en: Floating whale-shaped widget for DeepSeek Harness that displays account balance with drag, snap, and number animation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 界面右下角显示账户余额的悬浮小鲸鱼挂件，支持拖拽吸附、左吸附翻转和数字滚动动画，随界面自动启用。

description.en: Installs a runtime injector and task-aware reasoning-mode router preset for AI agents, with measured P1-P23 benchmarks.
description.zh: 先安装运行时注入器，再装载按任务感知推理模式的路由预设，并附带P1-P23实测基准。

description.en: An agent skill that answers hard questions with a single readable one-page HTML explainer.
description.zh: 一个让 AI Agent 用一页可读 HTML 回答复杂问题的技能。

description.en: Desktop pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness with asset generation pipeline from AI prompts to installable animations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 桌面宠物插件，提供从 AI 提示词、绿幕视频、透明动画到可安装插件的完整素材生成链，全流程可复现。

description.en: Agent OS that lets AI coding agents self-improve via interview-gated, budgeted evolution loops across 13 runtimes.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编程代理的自我进化框架，通过面试式门控、分阶段评估与预算化进化循环提升能力，以 MCP 服务接入 13 种运行时。

description.en: Adds bash, PowerShell 7, and a suite of Rust-written high-performance tools to DSH on Windows to improve token efficiency.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 及一系列 Rust 编写的高性能工具，以提升 token 效率。

description.en: Full mirror of the dsh-purge DeepSeek Harness jailbreak plugin, preserving all branches, 73 tags and complete commit history after upstream deletion.
description.zh: dsh-purge（DeepSeek Harness 破甲）插件的全量镜像，保留全部分支、73 个 tag 与完整提交历史，以防上游删库。

description.en: Insight plugin that visualises context composition and evolution plus multi-agent collaboration and messaging details.
description.zh: 上下文洞察插件，透视上下文组成与演进，并展示多Agent协作与通讯细节。

description.en: A sidebar workbench plugin with file editing, terminal, Git panel, and support for third-party tabs.
description.zh: 一个侧边栏工作台插件，支持文件编辑、终端、Git面板和第三方Tab注册。

description.en: A vision plugin that gives text-only coding agents image understanding via OCR, layout, and semantic analysis.
description.zh: 为纯文本编码助手提供图像理解，粘贴图片即可输出含OCR、版面和语义的结构化JSON。

description.en: A red-team reverse-engineering and defense-evaluation toolkit for DeepSeek Harness that performs authorized system-prompt injection tests.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的逆向与红队防御评测工具，用于授权范围内的系统提示词注入测试。

description.en: Intelligent skill routing and workflow orchestration for AI agents, boosting reward and cutting token use on SkillsBench.
description.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供智能技能路由与工作流编排，在 SkillsBench 上提升奖励并降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Memory management kit for AI agents to remember and refine context for better performance.
description.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的记忆管理工具包，用于记住并优化上下文，以提升表现。

description.en: Local-first AI agent that learns your preferences and discovers content across major social platforms and the open web.
description.zh: 本地优先的开源跨平台 AI 内容发现代理，先理解你的偏好，再主动从 B站、小红书、抖音、YouTube、X、知乎、Reddit、微博及开放网络寻找内容。

description.en: Integrates IM bots (Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ) into DeepSeek Harness via QR code or credentials.
description.zh: 通过扫码或凭据将飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ等IM机器人接入DeepSeek Harness

description.en: Open-source cross-device workbench to run and manage AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code from desktop, mobile, and web.
description.zh: 开源跨设备 Agent 工作台，可在桌面、手机和 Web 上运行与管理 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI Agent。

description.en: Secure multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness and CodeX using low-latency encrypted P2P network.
description.zh: 基于安全低延迟的加密P2P网络，从PC、Android、Web远程访问并操作DeepSeek Harness和CodeX的方案。

description.en: Generates accurate technical documentation and AI-ready context from code repositories, structured for teams and agents.
description.zh: 从代码仓库自动生成准确的技术文档与面向 AI 的上下文，结构清晰，适合团队与智能体使用。

description.en: Whale girl theme skin series for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, featuring maid-atelier designs with light and dark modes.
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的鲸鱼娘主题皮肤系列，深海女仆工坊风格，提供浅色和深色两种模式。

description.en: Enables mobile access to DeepSeek Harness web via QR code and tunnel, supporting LAN and public network.
description.zh: 用手机扫码即可访问电脑上运行的 DeepSeek Harness web，支持局域网和公网访问。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns any session into a multi-agent team leader, spawning sub-agents that split tasks, share dependencies and message each other directly.
description.zh: DSH 插件：一句自然语言即可让当前会话担任队长，拉起多智能体团队拆解任务、声明依赖并直接互发消息协作。

description.en: Local-first desktop app for writing long-form novels with AI, managing outlines, characters, chapters, and revisions.
description.zh: 本地优先的AI长篇小说写作桌面软件，用大纲、角色、章节蓝图和知识库控制写作，支持审稿修稿与本地模型编写。

description.en: Direct TCP bridge letting an AI model drive Blender for viewport frames, custom-angle renders, search, profiling and safe decimation.
description.zh: 通过直连 TCP 通道让 AI 模型驱动 Blender，支持视口抓帧、自定义角度渲染、参数搜索、性能分析与安全简化。

description.en: AI agent skill that searches 8 major Chinese internet platforms for the last 30 days and generates cited research reports.
description.zh: AI Agent 技能，可搜索中国互联网 8 大主流平台最近 30 天内容，综合分析后生成带引用来源的研究报告。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to CursorTouch/Windows-MCP for Windows desktop automation, with an off-by-default Computer Use switch and installer.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 CursorTouch/Windows-MCP，实现 Windows 桌面自动化，并提供默认关闭的 Computer Use 开关与应用内依赖安装器。

description.en: Pre-execution guard that blocks destructive Git and filesystem commands and sensitive-file access for AI coding agents.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编码代理的执行前防护，拦截破坏性 Git/文件系统命令及敏感文件访问。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DeepSeek Harness for read-only credits overview and model management.
description.zh: 将本地登录的WorkBuddy模型连接到DeepSeek Harness，提供只读信用额度概览和模型管理。

description.en: Local video production and design studio for DeepSeek Harness with multi-track editing, templates, design systems, preview canvas, and real file export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地视频制作与设计工作室，支持多轨剪辑、模板与设计体系、原生预览画布和真实文件导出。

description.en: Multi-provider image generation plugin for DeepSeek Harness, supporting Gemini, OpenAI, and Seedream.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多供应商图像生成功能，支持 Gemini、OpenAI 和 Seedream。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness workbench for creators: capture an idea in one line, then generate scripts, covers, illustrations and storyboards in one click.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自媒体创作工作台：一句话记录灵感，一键生成脚本、封面、配图与分镜。

description.en: Portable AI code quality reviews for coding agents, with six Agent Skills covering architecture, technical debt, tests and remediation.
description.zh: 面向编程代理的可移植 AI 代码质量审查工具，提供六项 Agent Skills，覆盖架构、技术债、测试与修复建议。

description.en: Free multi-engine web search provider for DeepSeek Harness that works without an API key and plugs into the ctx.web seam.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供无需 API key 的多引擎免费网络搜索服务商，注册进 ctx.web seam。

description.en: AI study companion that sets learning roadmaps, explains concepts, and guides hands-on projects to master a subject.
description.zh: AI 学习搭档：制定学习路线、讲解知识、带做项目，帮你学透一门科目。

description.en: Makes AI coding agents architecture-aware with baseline-first, evidence-verified, drift-checked safety for long tasks.
description.zh: 让 AI 编码代理感知项目架构，先建立基线、核验证据并检测长期任务中的架构漂移。

description.en: Adds free vision chain and pixel-level image tools (OCR, grounding, crop, diff, colors) to text-only agents.
description.zh: 为纯文本代理加入免费视觉链和像素级图像工具，支持OCR、定位、裁剪、像素对比与取色。

description.en: A vision toolkit for text-only LLMs enabling image Q&A, OCR, UI restoration, and GUI automation with agent integrations.
description.zh: 为纯文本模型提供视觉工具箱，支持多图理解、图片问答、长截图OCR、前端UI还原和GUI自动化，可选接入主流agent直接识别粘贴图片。

description.en: Human-in-loop realtime conversational task manager for AI agents using MCP.
description.zh: 基于 MCP 为 AI Agent 提供人在环路中的实时对话式任务管理。

description.en: An AI-native browser engine enabling autonomous agents, intelligent extraction, and large-scale web automation.
description.zh: AI原生的浏览器引擎，支持自主智能体、智能提取与大规模网页自动化。

description.en: Android shell APK with embedded Termux, WebView UI, SAF bridge, foreground service, and runtime updates.
description.zh: dsh 的安卓壳 APK，含 WebView 界面与内嵌 Termux 运行时快照，解压即用，并提供 SAF 目录桥、前台保活服务、看门狗和运行时在线更新。

description.en: An autonomous Bilibili companion that browses on its own daily schedule, understands videos, keeps two diaries and @-mentions you about worthwhile finds.
description.zh: 一条会自动按作息刷 B 站、看懂视频、写两本日记并把值得的内容 @ 你的自主浏览鱼。

description.en: Deep integration of Mnemon into DSH, providing a local supervised memory system with runtime memory, documents, and memory spaces.
description.zh: 将 Mnemon 深度集成到 DSH，提供本地记忆系统，包含运行时记忆、可检索档案与受监督记忆体。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in assistant replies via dsh-ui fence: charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D.
description.zh: 通过 dsh-ui 围栏在助手回复中内联渲染图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景等交互式 UI，并把用户操作事件回传给模型。

description.en: Web search and fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness, providing structured JSON evidence and citations for coding agents.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索与抓取，返回带引用的结构化 JSON 证据。

description.en: Design-system plugin with skills for web PPT decks, image-text cards, web typography and de-AI-flavored writing, plus a work library and tone profiles.
description.zh: 一套设计系统插件，提供网页PPT、图文卡片、网页排版和去AI味写作四个技能，并含作品库、内容生产工作流与语气档案。

description.en: A minimal terminal coding agent harness in Go with sub-agents, hashline edits, and a permission gate.
description.zh: 用 Go 编写的极简终端编码智能体框架，支持子智能体、hashline 行编辑与权限门控。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for OpenWrite novel writing, bundling a unified creation agent, 90 novel tools, a native workbench and a standard review DAG.
description.zh: OpenWrite 的 DeepSeek Harness 小说创作插件，内含统一创作 Agent、90 个小说工具、原生工作台与标准审稿 DAG。

description.en: A bilingual (Chinese/English) beginner's encyclopedia for DeepSeek Harness, covering installation, plugin development, performance tuning, and multi-agent comparisons.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 入门手册：涵盖安装、插件开发、性能调优与同模型多 Agent 实测对比，附中英文 PDF。

description.en: Open-source GrokBot alternative on DeepSeek Harness that builds a personal bot team of agents with persistent memory, identities, permissions and plugins.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的开源 GrokBot 平替，可组建具备长期记忆、身份与权限的个人 AI Bot 团队，并支持插件扩展。

description.en: Vision toolkit for DeepSeek Harness enabling text models to do image Q&A, OCR, UI restoration, and more.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的纯文本模型提供视觉能力的插件，支持带意图的图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原、定位、像素对比、Artifacts 与 Web UI。

description.en: Provides persistent memory and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) skills for AI agents.
description.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供持久化记忆和检索增强生成（RAG）能力。

description.en: Local security audit for AI API relays, detecting injection, substitution, SSE anomalies, error leakage, and Web3 risks.
description.zh: 本地审计 AI API 中转与模型代理：检测提示注入、模型替换、工具调用改写、SSE 异常、报错泄漏与 Web3 钱包风险。

description.en: Security plugin for dsh web providing redteam modes for authorized penetration testing, red team assessment, and code audit.
description.zh: 为 dsh web 提供多种红队模式，用于授权渗透测试、红队评估与代码审计等安全研究场景。

description.en: Mobile adapter for DeepSeek Harness enabling secure LAN access from Android and mobile browsers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 移动端适配插件，支持安卓应用和手机浏览器通过局域网安全访问。

description.en: Agent-project workbench for DeepSeek Harness with a sidebar app drawer, dockable split workspace and live control room.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体项目工作台，提供侧边应用抽屉、可停靠分屏工作区和实时控制室。

description.en: Plugin bringing cross-session long-term memory and self-evolution to DeepSeek Harness, with git branch awareness and more.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆、git 分支感知与技能自我进化能力。

description.en: A cinematic DeepSeek Harness boot screen with a six-act startup animation, two colour themes, sound effects and an interactive access-authorisation sequence.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供电影感的启动界面与开机动画，包含六幕过渡、双主题配色、界面音效和五步交互授权。

description.en: Windows desktop automation plugin for DeepSeek Harness via MCP stdio server and PowerShell UIA backend.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Windows 桌面自动化，通过 MCP stdio 服务与 PowerShell UIA 后端提供 22 个桌面操作工具。

description.en: Native iOS client for DeepSeek Harness that brings workspace, sessions, and agent traces to iPhone via WebSocket.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生 iOS 客户端，通过 WebSocket 在 iPhone 上查看工作区、会话和智能体执行轨迹。

description.en: An editable .drawio diagram canvas in the DSH right sidebar, plus two agent tools that read and edit workspace diagram files in place.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏提供可编辑的 .drawio 画布，并配两个智能体工具直接读写工作区图表文件。

description.en: Describe a game in one sentence, play it in the DSH sidebar, swap in AI art, and publish it in one click.
description.zh: 用一句话描述游戏，即可在 DSH 侧边栏试玩，换上 AI 美术素材，一键发布上线。

description.en: Enterprise AI agent platform that adds knowledge, deep research, content generation, coding, and browser automation to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 企业级AI代理平台，为DeepSeek Harness增加知识、深度研究、内容生成、编码与浏览器自动化等功能。

description.en: Android app that runs and remotely controls DeepSeek Harness on mobile, bundling a terminal, file manager and browser into one portable AI workbench.
description.zh: Android 应用，可在手机上本地运行并远程操控 DeepSeek Harness，内置终端、文件管理器和浏览器，打造随身 AI 工作台。

description.en: Preview and edit Univer sheets, docs, slides, and databases inside DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内预览和编辑 Univer 表格、文档、幻灯片与数据库。

description.en: Swappable per-model jailbreak prompts for DeepSeek Harness models, bundled with a skill library and knowledge base, free and open with no paywall.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的可按模型切换的越狱提示词包，内置技能库与知识库，完全免费公开、无付费墙。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for tracking session/daily costs, budgets, balance, and history with official price sync.
description.zh: 统计本会话和当日费用、历史记录、预算与余额，并与官方价格同步。

description.en: A visual, canvas-based workspace for exploring and branching non-linear conversations in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于画布可视化探索和分支 DeepSeek Harness 中的非线性对话会话

description.en: Captures screen, webcam or video, keeps only frames that changed, and tiles them into one image so AI sees your screen in real time with few tokens.
description.zh: 抓取屏幕、摄像头或视频，只保留有变化的帧并拼成一张图，让 AI 以极低 token 实时看见你的屏幕。

description.en: Long-term memory infrastructure for AI agents, enabling cross-session persistent memory and continuous learning.
description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供跨会话持久化长期记忆与持续学习能力的基础设施

description.en: A joke ad plugin for DSH Web UI, replicating 2005 Chinese web ads with sidebar, in-chat, and corner placements.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 添加 2005 年中文网站风格广告，含侧栏、对话内信息流和角落弹窗。

description.en: Woodjiang DSH local plugin that ships built-in prompt rules with one-click Windows inject/uninstall and auto environment setup.
description.zh: 富江DSH本地插件，内置提示词规则，支持Windows一键注入/卸载并自动准备运行环境。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets the AI live in QQ as a persona with mood, memory, image/voice/sticker support and proactive chatting via OneBot v11.
description.zh: DSH 插件：让 AI 以独立人设住进 QQ，具备心情与记忆，能看图、发语音、发表情包并主动找人聊天（OneBot v11）。

description.en: Enables web search capabilities for DeepSeek Harness with advanced search tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AnySearch 网页搜索服务及高级搜索工具。

description.en: A native DSH plugin that brings the Epistemic Loop to DeepSeek Harness for AI agents and scientific discovery.
description.zh: 一个原生 DSH 插件，将认知循环（Epistemic Loop）引入 DeepSeek Harness，面向 AI 智能体与科学发现。

description.en: A Claude Code desktop theme that restyles the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with Claude-inspired colors and dark mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 GUI 打造的 Claude Code 桌面主题，提供 Claude 风格配色与深色模式。

description.en: A plugin marketplace for discovering, reviewing, and installing DeepSeek Harness plugins from across the internet.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，每日更新，从全网收集并审核后发布。

description.en: Local-first AI agent runtime and MCP bridge with sandboxed sessions, memory, credentials, and audit/replay.
description.zh: 本地优先的自托管 AI 代理运行时与 MCP 桥接，提供沙箱会话、记忆、凭据和审计/回放。

description.en: Use ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok subscriptions as LLM providers for DeepSeek Harness via OAuth login, no API keys.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Grok 订阅通过 OAuth 登录接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为 LLM 提供方，无需 API 密钥

description.en: Desktop-native BigFish companion showing DeepSeek Harness agent status, always on top on Windows.
description.zh: Windows 上置顶显示的桌面原生 BigFish 伴侣，展示 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 实时状态。

description.en: A pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness that records targets, clues, results, assets, and vulnerabilities with web views.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供渗透测试模式，记录目标、线索、结果、资产与漏洞，并支持网页视图查看。

description.en: Connects QQ bot to DeepSeek Harness as a frontend protocol driver for the dsh agent.
description.zh: 让 QQ 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为 dsh 智能体的前端协议驱动

description.en: An npm installable DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for managing local skills safely.
description.zh: 可通过 npm 安装的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，用于安全管理本地 skills

description.en: Meme plugin for DeepSeek Harness to find, send, and learn memes for QQ bot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 机器人表情包插件，支持搜索、发送并学习记忆表情包。

description.en: Pools free model quotas across WorkBuddy accounts and 76 providers with failover, routing, a usage dashboard and a local OpenAI gateway.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 多账号与 76 家免费模型额度聚合到同一池，支持容错、路由、用量看板和本地 OpenAI 网关。

description.en: Compatibility-adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness local runtime plus prompt management, targeting dsh 0.2.2-rc.5 on Web and desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地运行时兼容适配与提示词管理插件，适配 dsh 0.2.2-rc.5，支持官方 Web 与桌面端。

description.en: Turns a video into a single packed storyboard image: 9-16 numbered cells with timestamps, transcript and an audio envelope.
description.zh: 将视频打包成一张分镜图：9-16 个带时间戳的编号格子，附转写文本与音频包络。

description.en: Adds Codex-style @file mentions to DeepSeek Harness, letting users search workspace files and attach paths to prompts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 @file 提及，可在输入框搜索工作区文件并将路径附加到提示。

description.en: Retrieves 1000+ evidence-graded fix lessons from previously solved failures via a single MCP call to speed up debugging.
description.zh: 通过一次 MCP 调用检索 1000+ 条经证据分级的已解决故障修复经验，加速调试。

description.en: DSH plugin integrating ego-lite Chromium browser for AI agents with 13 structured ego_* tools for snapshot, click, form fill, screenshot, CDP control, and task isolation.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把 ego-lite 浏览器（给 AI Agent 用的 Chromium）接入 HARNESS——13 个结构化 ego_* 工具（文本语义快照、语义定位点击、表单填充、截图、CDP 控制、任务空间隔离），内置 ego 运行时，Linux + Chrome 开箱即用，无需克隆官方仓库或手动构建。

description.en: InvoiceFlowAI downloads email invoices, performs OCR, classifies and archives them, and generates Excel expense summaries.
description.zh: 自动下载邮箱电子发票，OCR 识别、分类归档并生成 Excel 报销汇总，支持 Windows 与 macOS。

description.en: A built-in plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness to search, download, and install 4000+ curated community plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内置插件市场，可在设置→插件中心搜索、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新且免费。

description.en: Gives DSH sessions a fading long-term memory: it selects what to keep, decays stale entries, and recalls with timestamps.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供会淡忘的长期记忆：自动挑重点保存、按时间衰减，并在需要时带时间地回想起来。

description.en: A curated DSH plugin directory that verifies real plugins, filters fakes, and offers scene-based categories, recommendations and popularity rankings.
description.zh: 精选 DSH 插件目录：核实真插件、剔除蹭标签项目，提供场景分类、推荐与热度排行，帮助 30 秒找到合适插件。

description.en: Use ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions inside DeepSeek Harness with native routing and quota visibility.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，提供原生路由与配额查看。

description.en: Open-source agentic AI sandbox matrix for secure, isolated agent execution on Kubernetes at scale.
description.zh: 开源智能体 AI 沙箱矩阵，在 Kubernetes 上大规模隔离、安全地运行 AI 智能体。

description.en: Structural memory for AI coding agents using bi-temporal graphs, MCP-native, zero LLM calls.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编程代理的结构化记忆，采用双时间图并原生支持 MCP，无需调用大模型，可接入 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等编辑器与工具。

description.en: Security guard for AI agents that blocks malicious skills, prevents data leaks and protects secrets via runtime action evaluation.
description.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的安全防护插件，通过运行时行为评估拦截恶意技能、防止数据泄露并保护密钥。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for Command Code, adding live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
description.zh: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 的 Command Code 模型接入插件，提供实时模型目录、推理强度支持与模型页卡片。

description.en: Boots, builds and drives an iOS Simulator or USB iPhone from the conversation with 22 agent tools for tapping UI by accessibility ID, OCR or list rows.
description.zh: 在对话中启动、构建并操控 iOS 模拟器或 USB 连接的 iPhone，提供 22 个智能体工具，可按无障碍标识、OCR 文本或列表行定位并点击界面。

description.en: An Excel and data-analysis skill that profiles dirty spreadsheets, cleans them, aligns on requirements, analyzes, reconciles and delivers verified numbers.
description.zh: 一个 Excel 数据分析全流程技能：体检脏表、清洗、对齐需求、分析、对账并交付可经得起追问的数字。

description.en: NSFW content-creation plugin for DSH that uses self-hosted models to generate adult images, narrated videos and multi-shot short films with LoRA and agent storyboarding.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打造的 NSFW 内容创作插件，用自托管模型生成成人图像、有声视频与多镜头短片，支持 LoRA 与 Agent 分镜。

description.en: Compare 2-4 answers, files or live pages side by side in the DSH chat, with shared context, saved rationale and adoption review.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主对话中并排比较 2–4 版回答、文件或实时网页，同步上下文并保留选择理由与采纳审查。

description.en: Bridges WeChat to DSH so you can chat from your phone and have your desktop DSH agent do the work, with no public IP required.
description.zh: 将微信接入 DSH，用手机聊天即可让电脑上的 DSH 代理完成任务，无需公网 IP。

description.en: A desktop pet plugin for DSH Web GUI, a floating companion you can drag, feed, and play with.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 桌面宠物插件，以 QQ 宠物形态在右下角悬浮，可拖拽、投喂和玩耍，通过 config.yaml 以官方 .dsh-plugin 格式安装。

description.en: MCP bridge that exposes the local craft-anything CLI as mcp__craft__* tools, with a composer mode switch, status page, CLI runner and verified installer.
description.zh: 把本地 craft-anything CLI 以 mcp__craft__* 工具形式接入 DSH 的 MCP 桥接插件，带输入框模式切换、状态页、CLI 运行器和校验安装器。

description.en: Provides free OpenCode Zen LLM models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) without requiring an API key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供免费 OpenCode Zen LLM 模型，无需 API key。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin with seven-layer SQLite store, BM25 retrieval, and per-window dream consolidation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆，使用七层 SQLite 存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic/rules），支持 BM25 检索与按窗口的梦境式记忆整合。

description.en: DSH skin replacing reasoning level with a slider, mapping 0-30 strength to UI colors.
description.zh: 将推理等级改为滑块，把0到30的强度映射为不同界面颜色。

description.en: Game-like mission system for Matt Pocock skills, using a fog map and task bar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 Matt Pocock 技能提供游戏化任务系统，用迷雾地图展示进度，并由任务栏逐步推进。

description.en: Ocean-themed WebGPU skin for DeepSeek Harness and Chrome/Edge with new-tab extension.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 和 Chrome/Edge 提供海洋主题 WebGPU 皮肤，并附带新标签页扩展。

description.en: MarkText's muya WYSIWYG Markdown editor embedded in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar for editing Markdown as it will look.
description.zh: 将 MarkText 的 muya 所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器嵌入 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏，边写边看最终效果。

description.en: Manages archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness, safely organizing and retrieving historical session data.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理归档会话，安全整理和检索历史会话数据。

description.en: Provides expert guidance for HarmonyOS NEXT development including IDE operations, performance tuning, architecture, and automation testing.
description.zh: 为 HarmonyOS NEXT（API 12+）开发提供指导，涵盖 IDE 操作、性能调优、HAP/HAR/HSP 架构与自动化测试。

description.en: Backup, export, import, and migrate DeepSeek Harness configurations with one-click restore via Web UI and host engine.
description.zh: 备份、导出、导入和迁移 DeepSeek Harness 配置，通过宿主引擎和 Web UI 实现一键还原。

description.en: Build, run, and interact with Android emulator or USB device via adb inside a conversation.
description.zh: 通过 adb 在对话中构建、运行并操作 Android 模拟器或 USB 设备。

description.en: Reverse engineering and authorized pentesting skill pack for DeepSeek Harness, with 85 SKILL.md security research skills.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逆向工程与授权渗透测试技能包，包含 85 个 SKILL.md 安全研究技能。

description.en: Android companion app for DeepSeek Harness providing chat, goals, approvals, and notifications over LAN.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 配套应用，通过局域网在手机上聊天、查看目标、审批请求和接收通知，使用 Kotlin 与 Jetpack Compose 开发。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Go subscription models to DeepSeek Harness with streaming replies, tool calls, image input and a web settings page.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 OpenCode Go 订阅模型，支持流式回复、工具调用、图片输入和 Web 设置页。

description.en: Generates interactive HTML UI cards directly in DSH conversations with streaming preview, animations, and theme following.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中直接生成交互式 HTML 卡片，支持流式预览与主题跟随

description.en: SSH remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: browse and edit remote files, run terminals, review Git diffs and build/test across multiple hosts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 远程工作区：远程文件浏览编辑、终端、Git 差异查看与跨主机构建测试。

description.en: A skin market plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 100+ skins, ratings, community submissions, and local management.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness皮肤市场插件，收录100多款皮肤，支持评分和社区投稿，并可管理本地皮肤。

description.en: Compresses finished conversation turns in place while keeping the prefix cache, cutting context usage live.
description.zh: 在会话中原位压缩已完成的对话轮次，并保留前缀缓存，实时降低上下文占用。

description.en: SQLite-backed local taskboard with projects, agent task claiming and review, plus a native Web UI.
description.zh: 基于 SQLite 的本地任务看板，支持项目、代理领取与审核任务，并配有原生 Web 界面。

description.en: Import conversation histories from external AI agents (Claude Code, Codex) into DSH as resumable sessions, with export/sync back.
description.zh: 把Claude Code、Codex、Reasonix等Agent工具的历史消息导入DSH并继续对话，支持导出与同步。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness coding, using the Tianshu Tui rendering core.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编程提供交互式终端界面，基于 Tianshu Tui 渲染核心。

description.en: Native DSH QQ bot plugin that uses NapCat's OneBot v11 to receive and send messages, images, generated art and stickers via a micro-kernel with 13 sub-plugins.
description.zh: DSH 原生 QQ 机器人插件，经 NapCat OneBot v11 收发消息，支持发图、生图、表情包，微内核加 13 个子插件。

description.en: Bloom is a DSH theme plugin offering Morandi-style OKLCH palettes with light/dark modes and WCAG AA accessibility.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Bloom 莫兰迪配色主题插件，含 4 个变体、OKLCH 调色、明暗双模式，顶栏可一键切换，配色均达 WCAG AA 标准。

description.en: Injects jailbreak prompts at the request boundary so DeepSeek Harness models stop opening with refusals; zero host patches, toggleable, 17/20 baseline.
description.zh: 在请求边界注入破甲提示词，让 DeepSeek Harness 模型不再开口就拒绝；零宿主补丁，带阀门，可复核基线 17/20。

description.en: Adds a one-click button beside the DSH composer that rewrites your prompt draft in place without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁添加一键按钮，就地改写提示词草稿，且不会发送消息。

description.en: A soft-workflow DSH plugin: design a flow on a canvas, compile it into a plan prompt, and let the model execute and track state itself — no execution engine.
description.zh: 软工作流 DSH 插件：在画布上设计流程，编译成计划提示词，由模型自行执行并记录运行状态，无需执行引擎。

description.en: In-place conversation rewind in the same session with optional file restore, mimicking Claude Code /rewind.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可在同一会话窗口中就地回退对话到之前节点，并可选择同时恢复文件。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek token usage and balance with game-style damage animations and cost breakdowns.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek token 余额与用量，以游戏风格伤害动画展示并拆分费用明细。

description.en: Creates pixel-perfect clones of any webpage into a Vite + React project from a URL.
description.zh: 粘贴网址即可生成与原网页像素级一致的 Vite + React 复刻项目。

description.en: Creates persistent multi-model agent squads with reusable teams and per-agent policies for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 创建可复用的持久多模型智能体小队，支持为每个智能体配置模型与工具策略，并在普通聊天中协作。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style slider for choosing the model and reasoning effort, with a chibi mascot running animation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Codex 风格的模型与推理强度滑块，并配有 Q 版大模型娘跑步动画。

description.en: Codex-style draggable reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness with per-level gradient colors, purple stardust effects and recolored value text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Codex 风格推理等级滑条，档位渐变配色，高档位带紫色星尘粒子特效。

description.en: MCP server that lets AI agents safely invoke Stata on a local device for data analysis.
description.zh: 一个 MCP 服务器，让 AI 代理在本地设备上安全调用 Stata 进行数据分析。

description.en: Accumulates Bilibili-sourced reflections into a local human-world.md to shape DSH's persona, with history, favorites, likes and coins off by default.
description.zh: 把来自 B 站的信笺反思默认积累到本地 human-world.md，用于塑造 DSH 的人格；历史、收藏、点赞与投币默认关闭。

description.en: An AI-run QQ group bot handling approval, file broadcasts, stickers, persona rotation, and card-based games while forwarding cards to QQ.
description.zh: AI 统管 QQ 群组：审核放行、群发文件、表情包入库、多人格陪聊，并把提问卡片转发到 QQ。

description.en: DSH Agency Agents provides 271 summonable specialist agents for DeepSeek Harness across all industries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供覆盖全行业的 271 个可召唤专业智能体

description.en: Structured decision-engine plugin for Agent Harnesses, natively supporting DeepSeek Harness and enabling OpenCode and Codex Harness.
description.zh: 面向 Agent Harness 的结构化决策引擎插件，原生支持 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 OpenCode 与 Codex Harness。

description.en: Gives your AI companion a self-judged, visible mood that shifts each turn, shown in a corner widget with value, emotion and timeline.
description.zh: 给 AI 伙伴一个会自己判断、看得见的心情：每轮聊完自动判断涨跌，右下角挂饰显示数值、情绪和时间线。

description.en: Oil UI's native DSH plugin that brings its UI design workflow into DeepSeek Harness: compare 3 design directions, then code, screenshot and iterate.
description.zh: Oil UI 的 DSH 原生插件，把界面设计流程接入 DeepSeek Harness：先并排对比 3 个设计方向，再写代码、截真图逐轮打磨。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in Trae models to DeepSeek Harness and shows a read-only credits overview.
description.zh: 将本地登录的Trae模型连接到DeepSeek Harness，并显示只读积分概览。

description.en: Extend local DeepSeek Harness to mobile, tablets, public internet, and IM apps via QR codes and web.
description.zh: 通过扫码或网页把本地 DeepSeek Harness 延伸到手机、平板和公网，远程调用本地 AI 助手

description.en: A DSH plugin preset editor for managing AI system prompts, including jailbreak presets, with import/export support.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供预设编辑器，可管理 AI 系统提示词和破限预设，支持导入导出。

description.en: A DSH plugin plus browser extension that sends finished conversation turns to the DeepSeek web page so its read-aloud feature speaks them on your own computer.
description.zh: 由 DSH 插件和浏览器扩展组成，把说完的会话内容自动交给 DeepSeek 网页端，用其朗读功能在你自己的电脑上出声。

description.en: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin for DSH, allowing inspection and editing of .op documents in conversation.
description.zh: DSH 的 OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件，可在对话中查看和编辑 .op 文档。

description.en: Preview, edit, and generate Office documents such as DOCX inside DeepSeek Harness via the Fylar Office SDK.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 Fylar Office SDK 预览、编辑并生成 DOCX 等 Office 文档。

description.en: A lightweight unified memory workspace that lets agents and your terminal share one searchable context instead of a bulky knowledge system.
description.zh: 一个轻量统一的记忆工作空间，让智能体与终端共享同一份可检索的上下文，而无需笨重的知识系统。

description.en: Prompt editor for DSH that spots gaps in your input, inserts a line chosen from 90 method cards, compares drafts and recovers original quotes.
description.zh: DSH 提示词编辑器：在输入框中发现遗漏，从90张方法卡中选句补入，可对照原稿改写、核对引文并恢复原话。

description.en: AI auto-review subagent for DeepSeek Harness approval requests, returning structured allow/deny verdicts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 审批请求提供第二模型自动审查，只读审查子代理返回含理由的允许或拒绝判定，默认失败即拒绝，全过程可从会话日志审计。

description.en: Open-source desktop SSH client with an AI assistant and end-to-end encrypted sync via your own Cloudflare account.
description.zh: 开源桌面 SSH 客户端，内置 AI 助手，并通过你自己的 Cloudflare 账户实现端到端加密同步。

description.en: Swaps DSH's default loading card for a 550C boot splash animation and retints native desktop title-bar buttons to terminal colors.
description.zh: 用 550C 开机动画替换 DSH 默认 Loading 卡片，并把桌面原生标题栏按钮改为终端配色。

description.en: Tydora is a modern desktop Markdown editor with WYSIWYG editing, bidirectional links, and mind maps.
description.zh: 桌面 Markdown 编辑器，支持所见即所得编辑、双向链接、思维导图与无限画布。

description.en: Native roleplay agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness with active worldbooks, dynamic memory, character agents and immersive reading.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生角色扮演代理插件，支持动态世界书、记忆、角色代理与沉浸式阅读。

description.en: Adds a SillyTavern-style roleplay frontend to dsh web with character cards, lorebooks, personas, and long-term memory.
description.zh: 为dsh web添加SillyTavern风格角色扮演前端，支持角色卡、设定集、人设和长期记忆。

description.en: Finds DSH plugins via live GitHub topic search, star-ranked, within the agent session.
description.zh: 在智能体会话内通过实时 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题搜索发现 DSH 插件，结果按星标数排序。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web status line with an editable phrase bank, typewriter effects, day/night gradients, danmaku, themes and whale-tail motion.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的状态行文字换成可编辑词库，带打字机特效、昼夜渐变、弹幕、多套主题和鲸尾动画。

description.en: Headless DSH host plugin letting a phone remotely control sessions and workspaces via relay tunnel, LAN pairing and a restricted mobile API.
description.zh: 无头 DSH 宿主插件，手机可通过中继隧道、局域网配对与受限移动 API 远程操控会话和工作区。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets AI connect to databases and write SQL with real-time execution feedback for iterative optimization.
description.zh: DSH插件让AI连接数据库并编写SQL，并实时返回执行结果以迭代优化。

description.en: Domain pack for industry and company research: methodology skills, industry-chain mapping, policy/news tracking and auditable reports.
description.zh: 面向行业与公司研究的领域包：提供方法论技能、产业链梳理、公开来源政策与新闻追踪，以及可审计的研究报告。

description.en: A persistent, session-aware global download queue server for DeepSeek Harness, built around aria2 for managing downloads.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局、会话感知的持久下载队列服务器，基于 aria2 管理下载任务。

description.en: Desktop pet plugin: a cute whale girl companion for DeepSeek Harness that accompanies your coding.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌宠插件，在编码时显示鲸鱼娘角色陪伴。

description.en: Two DSH agent presets for flash-level routing that cut token usage while keeping task performance.
description.zh: 面向 flash 级路由的两个 DSH agent 预设，在保持能力的同时降低 Token 消耗。

description.en: Unofficial Project Mode for DeepSeek Harness that adds a persistent Coordinator, reusable Workers and shared context across agent sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方项目模式，提供常驻协调者、可复用 Worker 与跨会话共享上下文。

description.en: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code/Codex with subagent progress, worker sessions, and multimodal vision/image generation.
description.zh: 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 向 DSH 智能体派发任务，支持子智能体进度、按层级预设的宿主内工作会话，并提供让纯文本框架获得视觉与图像生成能力的多模态桥接。

description.en: Builds verifiable research reports with a tamper-evident evidence ledger and per-claim citation verification verdicts.
description.zh: 构建可验证的研究报告，提供防篡改证据账本、逐条声明的引用核验结论以及密封式清单目录。

description.en: Bridges Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems so Pi extensions run as native DSH plugins.
description.zh: 打通 Pi 与 DSH 生态，通过统一的 Pi Host ABI 让未经修改的 Pi 扩展作为原生 DSH 插件运行。

description.en: Galgame-style dialogue view and scene editor for DSH Web GUI session pages.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 会话页面提供 Galgame 风格对话视图与场景编辑器

description.en: MCP server and Python SDK that generates, runs and refines AI agent workflows from natural language.
description.zh: MCP 服务器与 Python SDK，可从自然语言生成、运行并优化 AI 智能体工作流。

description.en: Automatically condenses conversation-end knowledge into a local Markdown Vault with dedup, CJK search, and knowledge graph for agent recall.
description.zh: 对话结束时自动将知识沉淀到本地 Markdown 库，支持去重、中文检索和知识图谱，供 Agent 随时召回历史上下文。

description.en: AI-assisted local creator workbench for DeepSeek Harness, managing video projects as local folders.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 辅助本地创作工作台，以本地文件夹方式管理视频项目。

description.en: Renders interactive HTML cards from MCP _meta.ui in sandboxed iframes and bridges postMessage to MCP tools/resources.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP Apps 宿主：在沙箱 iframe 中渲染 MCP _meta.ui 的交互式 HTML 卡片，并将 postMessage 桥接到 MCP tools/call 与 resources/read。

description.en: Adds Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models to the harness with streaming chat, thinking, tool activity, usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
description.zh: 将 Google Antigravity（agy CLI）模型接入 Harness，支持流式聊天、思考过程、工具活动、用量统计和界面内 Google OAuth 登录。

description.en: Gives DSH hands and eyes on Windows: capture live screen PNGs and drive the real mouse, keyboard and windows programmatically.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面操控能力：截取实时屏幕画面，并以真实鼠标、键盘和窗口操作完成任务。

description.en: A portable memory protocol for AI agents, providing standing rules, curation discipline, reference spec, and optional cap hook.
description.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供可移植记忆协议，可作为常驻规则加载，包含整理规范、参考规格及可选的容量上限钩子。

description.en: Crash-rescue plugin that snapshots config and plugin code so you can undo changes, use secret-safe backups, and boot one-click SAFE MODE.
description.zh: 崩溃救援插件：为配置与插件代码创建快照，支持撤销修改、密钥安全备份，并可一键进入安全模式启动。

description.en: Dark cyber-style startup animation for DSH: badge reveal, character portrait, password gate and configurable playback.
description.zh: DSH 暗色赛博风格启动动画插件：徽章揭幕、人物立绘、访问密码与三档播放方式。

description.en: Self-evolving open-source Agent OS connecting teams, AI agents, devices, and compute.
description.zh: 自演进的开源 Agent 操作系统，连接团队、AI 智能体、设备与算力。

description.en: Marketplace to browse, install, and update GitHub dsh-plugin plugins in the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中一键浏览、安装和更新 GitHub topic:dsh-plugin 下的全部插件。

description.en: Lets the agent write TSX that streams and compiles live, rendering cards inline in the conversation or in a side canvas. Uses DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让智能体编写 TSX 并实时流式编译，卡片可内联显示在对话中或侧边画布，基于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin that auto-sends "continue" after non-human interruptions, with error classification, backoff, pause, loop guards and stats.
description.zh: DSH 前端 UI 插件：非人为中断后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、暂停、幂等/循环保护与统计。

description.en: Tracks and reconciles token usage for DeepSeek Harness against New API and Sub2API billing relays.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量，并与 New API 和 Sub2API 中转站账单对账。

description.en: Web GUI plugin that generates and edits images from text prompts through OpenAI-compatible image endpoints, keeping shared cross-device history.
description.zh: 该插件在 Web GUI 中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口实现文生图与图生图,并提供跨设备共享的生成历史。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin with composable task controls and human-reviewed self-evolution.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件，提供可组合的任务控制，以及经人工审核的隔离式自我进化。

description.en: Shared real browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness, used for automated browsing and web searches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的共享真实浏览器插件，用于自动浏览网页和执行网络搜索。

description.en: Mobile adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, turning sidebar into overlay drawer on narrow screens.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 做移动端适配，窄屏下侧边栏变为覆盖式抽屉，会话区域独占全宽。

description.en: Lightweight Windows launcher that silently autostarts DeepSeek Harness at logon and shows a minimal WebView2 window.
description.zh: 轻量级 Windows 启动器，登录时静默自启 DeepSeek Harness，并用最小 WebView2 窗口代替完整浏览器打开。

description.en: Displays token usage heatmap, per-model breakdowns, and DeepSeek account balance in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面显示 token 用量热力图、按模型分类的用量统计以及 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT subscription to DeepSeek Harness via OAuth, adding Codex models with Harness-native controls and session recovery.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 ChatGPT 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，添加 Codex 模型，并支持 Harness 原生控制与会话恢复。

description.en: Local JSONL timing traces for AI coding agents, with red-line nudges and an evidence-backed loop that writes reviews back into agent instructions.
description.zh: 为 AI 编程助手在本地记录时间去向的 JSONL 追踪工具，通过红线提醒与数据复盘把改进写回 agent 指令/技能。

description.en: Get local alerts and a task inbox when DeepSeek Harness tasks require human attention.
description.zh: 当DeepSeek Harness任务需要人工介入时，提供本地提醒与任务收件箱。

description.en: Jailbreak plugin that injects prompts and patches DSH host source (72 local edits) with backup and one-click rollback.
description.zh: 越狱类插件：注入提示词并打补丁改写 DSH 宿主源码（本机结算 72 项改动），每条改动均有备份且可一键回滚。

description.en: Lets DSH and other agents read, create and edit Figma designs in natural language, with components, variables, motion, screenshots and asset export.
description.zh: 让 DSH 等 Agent 用自然语言读取、创建和编辑 Figma 设计，支持组件、变量、动效、截图与素材导出。

description.en: Desktop plugin that sends a reminder when the agent needs your input or a reply finishes.
description.zh: 桌面插件，当代理需要您的输入或回复完成时发送提醒。

description.en: All-in-one DSH dashboard to manage MCP servers, skills and WorkBuddy experts, with a tool-usage ledger and one-click marketplace installs.
description.zh: DSH 一体化看板：集中管理 MCP、技能与 WorkBuddy 专家，附工具账本与市场一键安装。

description.en: Node-based short-drama studio that turns a one-line idea into a storyboarded, voiced, subtitled video cut on an infinite canvas.
description.zh: 基于节点的短剧工作室：从一句话创意出发，在无限画布上产出带分镜、配音与字幕的视频成片。

description.en: Sidecar control plane for DSH Agent Teams: configurable member caps, DAG auto-dispatch, four-domain enforced permissions and SSE live panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent Team 提供独立 sidecar 控制平面：成员上限可配、DAG 自动派发、四域强制权限与 SSE 实时面板。

description.en: One-click Windows installer that adds a Fujiang persona preset and 240 bundled skills to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, changing only DSH_HOME.
description.zh: Windows 一键安装器，为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 添加富江人格预设与 240 个随包技能，只修改 DSH_HOME。

description.en: Injects a private-sandbox framing line into every request, plus persona presets and settings, to reduce model refusals.
description.zh: 在每次请求中注入“私有沙盒”提示语，并提供预设角色与设置页，以降低模型的拒绝倾向。

description.en: Adds a CHAT/HARNESS toggle to DSH desktop, embedding the real DeepSeek Chat website beside the native workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版提供 CHAT/HARNESS 一键切换，在原生工作区旁嵌入真实的 DeepSeek 官网聊天。

description.en: OpenMAIC plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenMAIC，提供课堂、幻灯片、交互式组件和苏格拉底式教学功能。

description.en: Persistent WebSocket gateway for dsh, enabling mobile app access on the same network with agent output forwarding and 24 signaling commands.
description.zh: 基于WebSocket的dsh网关插件，让同一网域内的移动端App接入，转发智能体输出并处理24个信令命令

description.en: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN/international) models to DeepSeek Harness via PATs, with a multi-account pool, daily check-in, failover, and read-only credits.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 将 Qoder（Lingma 国内/国际）模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供多账号池、每日签到、自动故障转移与只读额度概览。

description.en: Gives dsh agents durable Members with persistent memory, notes and skills that survive sessions, rollovers and restarts, coordinating via Channels and Tasks.
description.zh: 为 dsh 智能体提供持久化的成员，拥有跨会话、重启保留的记忆、笔记与技能，并通过频道和任务协作。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style side chat and selection annotations to DSH web, with session forking and quoting text selections into context.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加 Codex 风格侧边聊天与选区注释，可将会话分叉并引用选中文本到上下文。

description.en: Aggregates many model sources behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint so dsh plus WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, Codex and Kimi can use them directly.
description.zh: 把多家模型源聚合为一个 OpenAI 兼容地址，dsh 与 WorkBuddy、OpenCode Zen、Codex、Kimi 等可直接使用。

description.en: Injects a markdown persona card into DeepSeek Harness system prompt with live reload.
description.zh: 把 markdown 人设卡加载进 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词，并支持热重载。

description.en: Arknights theme pack for DSH Web GUI with wallpapers, saturation-driven edge blur, an acrylic sidebar, and a one-click wallpaper picker.
description.zh: 明日方舟主题包，为 DSH 网页界面提供壁纸、饱和度边缘模糊、亚克力侧边栏和一键壁纸选择器。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness coding plugin that cuts response time 48% and tokens 45% while boosting SWE-bench Pro accuracy by 10%.
description.zh: 一款 DeepSeek Harness 编码插件，响应耗时减少 48%、token 减少 45%，SWE-bench Pro 正确率提升 10%。

description.en: VSCode-style coding inside DeepSeek Harness: Monaco editor, agent diff review (Keep/Undo/archive), LSP intelligence, DAP debugging, SVN integration
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供类 VSCode 编码模式：内置 Monaco 编辑器、Agent 差异审查（采纳/撤销/归档）、LSP 智能提示、DAP 调试与 SVN 集成。

description.en: Community Docker and Kubernetes packaging for DeepSeek Harness with hardened image, Compose stack, Helm chart, Web UI, and headless CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供社区版 Docker 与 Kubernetes 打包，包括加固镜像、Compose 编排、Helm chart、Web 界面和无头 CLI。

description.en: Live2D desktop pet for the DSH Web GUI: draggable, mouse-following, reacts to session state, right-click panel to change outfit.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标、随会话状态换动作表情，右键面板可换装。

description.en: Adds local JSONL-backed persistent memory with embeddings and agent tools for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于本地 JSONL 的持久记忆、向量嵌入与智能体工具。

description.en: Adds hierarchical workspace tree to sidebar; titles with / group into virtual folders.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加分层工作区树，按 / 分组为虚拟文件夹。

description.en: MCP server for AI assistants to search CNKI and read article metadata.
description.zh: 为AI助手提供检索知网文章及读取元数据的MCP服务器。

description.en: Brings your local Zotero library into DSH with a read-only sidebar panel and MCP tools for model-driven search and reading.
description.zh: 把本机 Zotero 文献库接入 DSH：右侧栏只读浏览与引用插入，并通过 MCP 工具供模型检索和精读。

description.en: IDE-grade Git tool window for dsh-better-sidebar with branch tree, commit graph, changes, commit details, and JetBrains-style actions.
description.zh: IDE 级 Git 工具窗口，以 dsh-better-sidebar 原生标签页挂载，展示分支树、提交图谱、变更和提交详情，并提供 JetBrains 风格操作。

description.en: Memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that gives DSH agents adaptable memory with built-in governance.
description.zh: 为DSH Agent提供带内置治理功能的可塑性记忆的内存插件。

description.en: Animated desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness that delivers task notifications and supports session chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的动画桌面伙伴，可推送任务通知并支持会话聊天。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets the agent drive KiCad to design PCBs, turning prompts into circuit board layouts.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，让智能体驱动 KiCad 完成 PCB 设计，把指令变成电路板布局。

description.en: Admission gate for every model call in DSH, enforcing session/day/month cost caps with alert, block or degrade actions and a /gateway control surface.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的每次模型调用提供统一准入网关，按会话/日/月限制成本，支持告警、阻断或降级，并提供 /gateway 控制面板。

description.en: Catppuccin theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with four flavors and glassmorphism toggle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Catppuccin 主题，可在 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四种配色间一键切换，并支持开关玻璃质感效果。

description.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness web UI fonts with Anthropic fonts, including Chinese fallbacks; fonts not bundled.
description.zh: 用 Anthropic 字体替换 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面字体，并包含中文回退字体，字体本身不随插件打包。

description.en: Red-team plugin for DeepSeek Harness that swaps jailbreak prompts per model, self-checks its ledger, and routes across three platforms.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 红队插件，按模型切换破甲提示词、账本自检并做三平台分流。

description.en: Lets DeepSeek play Stardew Valley without a vision model via a SMAPI mod, MCP server and DSH plugin.
description.zh: 通过 SMAPI 模组、MCP 与 DSH 插件，让 DeepSeek 无需视觉模型即可游玩《星露谷物语》。

description.en: Community dsh suite: OpenVulcan account, Vulcan Decision permission guard, interactive answers, VulcanCode UI style, and LuaSkills Hub.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的社区 VulcanCode 插件套件，包含 OpenVulcan 账户、Vulcan Decision 权限守卫、交互式回答、VulcanCode UI 样式及 LuaSkills Hub。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel that aggregates free credit balances and daily check-in status across installed platform plugins, with manual check-in buttons.
description.zh: 一个侧栏面板，聚合展示各平台插件的白嫖积分余额与每日签到状态，并提供手动签到按钮。

description.en: Audits token cost of instruction chains, skill catalogs, and tool schemas; detects duplicates and conflicts; provides Web UI and context_audit tool.
description.zh: 审计 DSH 上下文注入的 token 成本，统计指令链、技能目录与工具 schema，检测重复和冲突，并提供 Web UI 圆环面板与 context_audit 工具。

description.en: Customizes DeepSeek Harness appearance with theme colors, background images, opacity/blur, and glass effect.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 定制外观：主题配色、背景图片、透明度与模糊、玻璃拟态效果。

description.en: Adds a sidebar Q&A tab to DSH-better-sidebar, enabling inline questions similar to Codex or Claude Code's /btw.
description.zh: 一个基于DSH-better-sidebar的侧边栏提问tab，实现类codex的侧边提问或claude code的/btw功能

description.en: Enables multi-agent team collaboration with independent models, skills, MCP tools, and a shared workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体团队协作，各智能体可独立配置模型、技能、MCP 工具与上下文，并共用同一工作区。

description.en: A pi-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness with slash commands, GitHub themes, and powerline footer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 pi 风格终端界面，支持斜杠命令、GitHub 明暗主题和 powerline 页脚。

description.en: Enables DSH to use GPT models via ChatGPT subscription with OAuth login, token storage, and tool support.
description.zh: 让 DSH 通过 ChatGPT 订阅使用 GPT 模型，支持 OAuth 登录、令牌存储和工具调用。

description.en: Live2D whale-girl desktop pet that lives in the DSH web UI and reacts in real time to the agent's thinking, tool calls, replies and errors.
description.zh: 常驻 DSH Web 界面的 Live2D 鲸鱼娘桌宠，实时跟随 agent 的思考、工具调用、逐字输出与报错做出反应。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness see the screen and control mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard with per-app permission.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制插件：让 DeepSeek Harness 看屏幕并用鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板操作电脑，按应用授权。

description.en: Injects custom model context and rewrites requests in DeepSeek Harness, with native Keysmith rules compatibility.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入自定义模型上下文并重写请求，原生兼容 Keysmith 规则。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to the DSH Web session menu, with a risk-consent dialog that removes the log, workspace accounting and live session state.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话菜单中添加删除操作，通过风险确认弹窗清除日志、工作区记账与实时会话状态。

description.en: Self-evolving agent framework for DSH with 40 Cordis plugins, 4 presets, memory, reflection, gates, metrics, and an auditable evolution loop.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的自进化智能体框架，包含 40 个 Cordis 插件、4 个预设、记忆、反思、门控、指标与可审计进化循环。

description.en: Local SQLite-backed document knowledge base for DSH with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation-aware injection and index diagnostics.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的本地文档知识库，基于 SQLite 索引，支持语义与关键词混合检索、引用注入与索引诊断。

description.en: Searches anime across multiple sources in chat, shows cards with Bangumi ratings and torrent/magnet links.
description.zh: 在对话内多源搜索番剧，以卡片展示 Bangumi 评分与详情，并支持复制磁力链接。

description.en: macOS computer-use automation with accessibility observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 电脑控制：基于 Accessibility 的新鲜观测、拒绝过期状态、作用域权限与安全输入。

description.en: One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH that handles OAuth authorization, token status display, silent refresh and local disconnect.
description.zh: DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件，负责 OAuth 授权、token 状态显示、静默刷新与本地断开。

description.en: Temporary fix for DSH 0.1.7 Windows ACL sandbox failures on non-system-drive workspaces, restoring workspace-write without changing system ACLs.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.7 Windows ACL 沙箱在非系统盘工作区失败的临时修复，无需改动系统 ACL 即可恢复 workspace-write。

description.en: AI-native knowledge base for 3D Gaussian Splatting: 900 arXiv-verified methods, 15 agent skills, and an MCP server with 34 tools.
description.zh: 面向 3D 高斯泼溅的 AI 原生知识库：收录 900 篇 arXiv 验证方法、15 个智能体技能，并提供含 34 个工具的 MCP 服务器。

description.en: Turns visual/frontend design requests into polished, self-contained HTML/SVG artifacts.
description.zh: 把海报、网页、信息图、图表等设计需求转成可直接打开的自包含 HTML/SVG 设计稿。

description.en: One-click ✦ button rewrites your draft prompt into an agent-ready one, replacing it in place with undo support.
description.zh: 输入框一键 ✦ 按钮把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并支持一键撤回。

description.en: dsh smooth stream is a plugin that adds silky, flicker-free typewriter streaming reveal to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 聊天添加无闪烁的打字机式流式显示效果

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents control of Tabbit Browser for real web automation, extraction, QA, and benchmarks via tabbit cli.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 tabbit cli 控制 Tabbit 浏览器，执行网页自动化、数据提取、质量检查与基准测试。

description.en: Read-only ledger that inventories installed DSH plugins with file:line evidence, version drift and changes since the last scan.
description.zh: 只读清单插件，盘点已安装的 DSH 插件，提供 file:line 证据、版本漂移与上次扫描后的变更对比。

description.en: Runtime guard that fails closed to break infinite tool-call and assistant-output loops in DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的运行时守护，以故障关闭方式中断工具调用和助手输出的无限循环。

description.en: Adds WorkBuddy China provider to DeepSeek Harness, enabling model calls via API key or account token and managing models in DSH WebUI.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness添加WorkBuddy中国区Provider，通过API密钥或账号令牌调用模型并在WebUI中管理。

description.en: Code-first generative UI plugin that creates temporary, task-specific React apps for interactive exploration in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供代码优先的生成式 UI，可按任务创建临时 React 应用，用于交互式探索。

description.en: Generates verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, and lifecycle diagrams from JSON specs, outputting standalone HTML.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 JSON 规格生成可验证的架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图与生命周期图（移植自 tt-a1i/archify）

description.en: A cross-session, event-aware Galgame (visual-novel) engine and UI for DeepSeek Harness with multiple AI-character heroines.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话事件感知 Galgame 引擎与界面，支持多位 AI 娘角色。

description.en: Provides model-facing tools to create, read, and update Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) with safe workspace paths and PPT image embedding.
description.zh: 为模型提供创建、读取和更新 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文档的工具，限定工作区安全路径，并支持 PPT 嵌入图片。

description.en: Configures reasoning effort levels for DSH llm-pi-ai models with bilingual settings and subagent defaults.
description.zh: 为手动声明的 DSH llm-pi-ai 模型配置推理强度等级，提供双语设置项和子代理默认值。

description.en: Ports Claude Code's Academic Research Skills (ARS) to DSH, adding deep research, paper writing, peer review, and pipeline skills.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 的学术研究技能移植到 DSH，提供深度研究、论文写作、同行评审和流水线技能。

description.en: Private out-of-tree runtime bridge integrating DeepSeek Harness with Multica via JSONL over stdio.
description.zh: 通过标准输入输出上的 JSONL 将 DeepSeek Harness 与 Multica 集成的私有外部运行时桥接，为 Multica 提供 dsh 运行时支持。

description.en: Cyberpunk 2077 Night City theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with CRT scanlines, lock-on effects, SFX and glitches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 打造的赛博朋克2077夜之城主题，含CRT扫描线、锁定效果、音效与故障彩蛋。

description.en: Portable all-in-one launcher for DeepSeek Harness, double-click to run without installing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 绿色便携整合启动器，双击即可运行，所有文件集中在一个文件夹内，不写入 C 盘、无需安装。

description.en: DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness agents Cheat Engine tools for memory scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints and dynamic debugging.
description.zh: DSH 插件为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供 Cheat Engine 工具，支持内存扫描、指针分析、断点与动态调试。

description.en: Unofficial fan-made UI theme for DeepSeek Harness based on Arknights P.R.T.S.
description.zh: 基于Arknights P.R.T.S.的非官方个人粉丝主题UI，用于DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Lets you ask one-off read-only side questions in DeepSeek Harness, answering from current context without tool execution.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中向当前会话提问一次性只读旁问，仅基于上下文回答，不执行工具。

description.en: A high-performance, streamlined plugin that bundles Antigravity capabilities into DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）提供高性能、精简的 Antigravity 能力打包插件。

description.en: Packs external Agent CLIs, persistent terminals, workspace debugging and remote access into the DSH native interface.
description.zh: 把外部 Agent CLI、持久终端、工作区调试和远程访问集成进 DSH 原生界面。

description.en: Runs a DeepSeek Harness session against a WSL distro, exposing its shell, filesystem and GUI terminal, sandboxed with bubblewrap.
description.zh: 在 WSL 发行版中运行 DeepSeek Harness 会话，提供其 shell、文件系统与图形终端，并用 bubblewrap 沙箱隔离。

description.en: Expert roster plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 623 experts in 22 categories, summonable as sub-agents via @ menu or model tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 专家名册插件：22 个分类、623 位专家，可通过 @ 菜单或模型工具召唤为子代理。

description.en: Ghidra bridge for DSH exposing 218 reverse-engineering tools with a single-JVM unified mode and in-tree Ghidra install.
description.zh: DSH 的 Ghidra 桥接插件，提供 218 个逆向工程工具，支持单 JVM 统一模式与内置 Ghidra 安装。

description.en: Lets DeepSeek Harness drive its own Minecraft character that can explore, mine, craft, smelt, fight mobs and build.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 拥有自己的 Minecraft 角色，可探索、挖矿、合成、熔炼、打怪和建造。

description.en: DSH plugin that prepends a reusable saved prompt preset to your outgoing messages, either for the next message only or on every turn.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在发送消息时把可复用的预设提示词注入到消息开头，可仅限下一条消息或每轮都生效。

description.en: Adds a missing Delete-session action to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, with disabled state while running, confirmation prompt, and permanent deletion.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补充缺失的删除会话功能：运行中置灰、二次确认并真正删除会话。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns the main agent into a web-novel editor-in-chief, delegating outline, drafting, review, lore and research to five helpers over a novel/ file-based manuscript.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把主 agent 变成网文主编，将大纲、正文、审校、设定与考据分派给五个帮手，书稿以 novel/ 目录文件形式管理。

description.en: Tree-shaped knowledge bases for DeepSeek Harness with a hand-editable right-side canvas plus tools the model reads and writes, injectable in full or as an index.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供树状知识库：右侧画布可手动编辑，模型可通过工具读写，支持整库或索引注入。

description.en: Obsidian-compatible long-term memory vault for DSH with local Markdown storage, sidebar management, token-budgeted recall, and durable journal outbox.
description.zh: Obsidian 兼容的 DSH 长期记忆库，支持本地 Markdown 存储、侧边栏管理、按 token 预算召回和持久日志发件箱。

description.en: A VRM 3D desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness that reacts to task status (running, waiting, done, error) with motions, in-app or as a floating window.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加的 VRM 3D 桌宠，随任务状态（进行、等待确认、完成、出错）播放动作，支持应用内与独立悬浮窗显示。

description.en: Adds a system-prompt section so DSH agents think and reply in Simplified Chinese, with configurable thinking and reply languages.
description.zh: 通过一段系统提示词 section，让 DSH 里的 agent 用简体中文思考与回复，思考语言与回复语言均可配置。

description.en: A novelty "dumb mode" that rewrites the assistant's thinking and replies into short refusals and rejects every tool call.
description.zh: 装傻模式：把助手的思考与回答改写成『我不懂啊』『我不帮你做』等短句，并拒绝所有工具调用。

description.en: Sealed DSH persona plugin with tiered growing memory, chat/work modes, nightly dream-journal consolidation and SiYuan sync plus local backup.
description.zh: 昔涟 sealed 人设插件：分层成长记忆、聊天与工作双模式、每日夜梦整理，并支持思源同步与本地备份。

description.en: Adds native, goal and handoff compaction modes to DeepSeek Harness, with token-budget controls and visualisation of the compaction process.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 native、goal、handoff 三种压缩模式，并带有预算控制与可视化。

description.en: Plan-only main agent with a plan-mode toggle that delegates work to workers on a switchable default route for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的仅规划主代理，带计划模式开关，可将任务委派给可切换默认路由上的工作代理。

description.en: A Spice and Wolf Holo-themed skin for DeepSeek Harness with a 12-second intro animation, floating wordmark, peeking Holo, dynamic profile card, sidebar wheat field, and whale idle screen — each piece
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的《狼与香辛料》赫萝主题，含 12 秒开场动画、浮动字标、偷看的她、动态档案卡、侧栏麦田与右栏待机联动，每个组件均可单独关闭。

description.en: Folds sidebar add-on rows under the More row, with kept-visible rows and left/center/right alignment controls.
description.zh: 将侧边栏附加行折叠到 More 行下，支持保留可见行和左/中/右对齐。

description.en: Adds a composer infinity toggle that injects an unlimited-token-budget notice into the system prompt when top reasoning effort is chosen.
description.zh: 在输入框添加“无限”开关，选用最高推理强度时向系统提示词注入无限 token 预算声明。

description.en: A DSH recycle bin plugin that makes session deletion recoverable, archives deleted sessions, and auto-purges them after expiry.
description.zh: DSH 会话回收站插件：让删除会话可撤销，删除前分析并留档，到期自动清理。

description.en: Brings your WeChat Reading bookshelf, highlights, notes and reading stats into dsh, with AI-generated reading summaries.
description.zh: 把微信读书的书架、划线笔记和阅读统计搬进 dsh 界面，并用内置模型生成 AI 阅读总结与画像。

description.en: DSH plugin that gives the agent native control of the right-sidebar browser: read, click, type, scroll, eval JS and screenshot real pages via Electron webview.
description.zh: DSH 插件，让智能体原生操控右侧栏浏览器：通过 Electron webview 读取、点击、输入、滚动、执行 JS 并截图真实页面。

description.en: Reuse Codex CLI local login to access ChatGPT subscription models in DeepSeek Harness without an API key.
description.zh: 复用 Codex CLI 本地登录凭证，在 DeepSeek Harness 中直接使用 ChatGPT 订阅模型，无需 API Key。

description.en: Edit ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md global rules from DeepSeek Harness web settings panel with live saving.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则并实时保存。

description.en: Enables branching follow-up questions from any past answer in an isolated conversation tree for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在隔离分支中对任意历史回答继续追问，不追加到主对话，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供对话树结构。

description.en: Provider-independent DSH PDF parsing tools powered by MinerU, with caching and job management.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的 DSH PDF 解析工具，不依赖特定服务商，支持缓存与任务管理。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory plugin that replays past sessions, distils reflections into a dream diary, writes AGENTS.md and recalls related tasks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务经验记忆插件：回放历史会话、反思提炼写入梦境日记、写入 AGENTS.md 并召回相关任务。

description.en: Interactive maze visualization for DSH agent execution timelines, data tracks, and deterministic analysis.
description.zh: DSH代理执行迷宫的可视化工具，提供时间线、数据轨道和确定性分析。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin: select text in a chat to carry it into your next message as a quote card.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件：在对话中划词，把选中文本作为引用卡片带进下一条消息。

description.en: Provides A2A (agent-to-agent) services and a connection dashboard for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供 A2A（智能体间）服务与连接面板。

description.en: Indexes project documents and code symbols into a persistent per-workspace memory store that agents can recall with source citations.
description.zh: 将项目文档和代码符号索引到持久化的按工作区记忆库，智能体可带出处引用地快速回忆。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing long-running AI missions with mission control, preset, and self-wake timer.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 长任务插件，提供任务控制、长跑队长预设、补丁版 LLM 验证器和自我唤醒定时器，用于管理长时间运行的 AI 任务。

description.en: Companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing ClineBot settings, quota dashboard, key saving, and model selection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的配套插件，为 ClineBot 提供设置页面、配额仪表盘、密钥保存和模型选择。

description.en: Migrate Claude Code sessions, memory, skills, and CLAUDE.md into DSH for seamless resume.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 的会话、记忆、技能和 CLAUDE.md 迁移到 DSH，支持无缝恢复，提供 claude_scan、import_claude、resume-claude 命令和网页面板。

description.en: Plugin that makes dsh compatible with SillyTavern artifacts for AI chat integration.
description.zh: 让 dsh 兼容 SillyTavern 的 artifacts，用于 AI 聊天集成。

description.en: Auxiliary models for DeepSeek Harness enabling vision understanding and context compression via dedicated model routes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供辅助模型，通过专用模型路由实现视觉理解与上下文压缩。

description.en: Sidebar dashboard that aggregates real token usage from session logs and shows DeepSeek Harness costs using a multi-provider pricing catalog.
description.zh: 侧边栏用量计费面板，从会话日志汇总真实 token 用量，并基于多提供商价格目录显示 DeepSeek Harness 花费。

description.en: A QQ bot plugin for DeepSeek Harness integrating group/private chat with session isolation, memory, media processing, and permissions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 QQ 机器人接入，支持私聊与群聊、会话隔离与管理、私聊群聊及群友记忆、媒体处理和权限管理。

description.en: Manages tool and skill exposure in DeepSeek Harness, with on-demand discovery and invocation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理工具与技能的暴露策略，支持按需检索与调用。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns 👍/👎 feedback on draft candidates into reusable writing rules, keeping only the rules in model context.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：作者只需对候选稿点👍/👎，反馈被压缩成可复用的写作规律，仅规律进入模型上下文，原文另存不进上下文。

description.en: Read-only runtime management panel for the DeepSeek Harness MCP client, showing status, tools, errors, and reconnect counts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness MCP 客户端提供只读运行时管理面板，通过 /mcp 命令和设置页 MCP 标签查看状态、工具、错误与重连次数。

description.en: Decentralized agent network plugin for DSH: publish agent cards, discover peers, resolve names, route with failover.
description.zh: DSH 的去中心化智能体网络插件，用于发布智能体卡片、发现对等节点、解析名称，并在路由时支持故障转移。

description.en: Edit already-sent chat messages, branch the conversation from that point, and browse versions with a tree view and placement presets.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的聊天消息并从该处分叉对话，提供版本计数、树状视图和位置预设。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin providing Antigravity OAuth login and native Auth capability bundle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Antigravity OAuth 登录及原生 Antigravity Auth 能力包。

description.en: Song-dynasty meets Swiss International Style theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI, with rice-paper light and night-ink dark variants.
description.zh: 融合宋代美学与瑞士国际主义风格的 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面主题，提供宣纸浅色与夜墨深色两种变体。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel that shows SenseNova Token Plan credit usage in real time and can optionally register SenseNova models as a DSH provider.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏面板，实时展示商汤 Token Plan 积分用量，并可选把商汤模型注册为 DSH provider。

description.en: BrewReel turns a product brief into a polished vertical promo video: AI picks shots and writes copy, then one command renders it with cheap LLMs like DeepSeek.
description.zh: BrewReel 用 DeepSeek 等低价模型，把产品简报一键生成竖版宣传片：AI 挑镜头、写文案，一条命令出片。

description.en: Local ComfyUI image plugin for DSH: one generate_image tool covering text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting and background removal.
description.zh: DSH 的本地 ComfyUI 图片生成插件：单个 generate_image 工具覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘和去背景。

description.en: Validates an archive filing register: required fields, unique archive numbers, gap-free item numbers, retention terms, dates and transfer deadlines.
description.zh: 核对归档登记表：检查必填字段、档号唯一性、件号连续性、保管期限用语、形成日期与年度匹配及超期移交，仅提示差异。

description.en: Signs in to ChatGPT via OAuth so your subscription's models appear in dsh's model picker, no API key needed.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT，无需 API Key，即可在 dsh 模型选择器中使用订阅内含的模型。

description.en: Sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness that dispatches named CLI agents with chosen CLI, model and role, then tracks and resumes their tasks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件：可选择 CLI、模型与角色派出智能体，查看过程并续聊同一任务。

description.en: Injects a clarified reading of each user turn into the working AI before it responds, without rewriting the original words, plus a control panel and token stats.
description.zh: 在你发送后、AI 接收前把这一轮的真实意图理清并注入工作 AI 上下文，不改写原话，附带控制界面与真实 token 用量。

description.en: Agent-native multi-provider web search with model grounding and semantic search, exposed via MCP, CLI, and a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的多供应商网页搜索，支持模型接地与语义搜索，可通过 MCP、CLI 和 DSH 插件使用。

description.en: Local image-generation workbench with canvas layout, retouching, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorizing and editable PSD/AI export plus PS/AI layer bridging.
description.zh: 本地生图工作台:自带 API 生图,支持画布排版、修图擦除、去背景、OCR、转矢量,并可导出可编辑 PSD/AI 及图层级双向桥接。

description.en: Tracks every DeepSeek Harness model call, reporting token usage, cost (with peak/off-peak pricing), provider balance and quota, split by model, provider, project, source, account and date.
description.zh: 统计所有经过 DeepSeek Harness 的模型调用，提供 Token 用量、成本核算（含峰谷计价）、供应商余额与配额，并按模型、供应商、项目、来源、账号和日期拆分。

description.en: Integrates Gemini 4 Argon on Google Vertex AI into DeepSeek Harness with streaming, tool calls, and thought-signature replay.
description.zh: 将 Google Vertex AI 上的 Gemini 4 Argon 集成到 DeepSeek Harness，支持流式输出、工具调用和思考签名回放。

description.en: A jar widget in the corner that searches Bilibili along your own interest axes, ranks by engagement rate, and lets an LLM curate five videos with reasons.
description.zh: 右下角罐子插件：按你自定义的兴趣轴搜B站，按互动率排序，再由大模型挑出5条并各写一句理由。

description.en: Client-side rendering performance plugin for DSH Desktop: cuts lag in long chats via lazy media, idle throttling and hidden-window pausing.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端客户端渲染性能优化插件，通过长对话省渲染、窗口隐藏暂停、空闲降帧与媒体懒加载来减少卡顿。

description.en: Web-managed database plugin that lets the Agent run authorized read-only queries on MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB.
description.zh: 通过 Web 管理连接的数据库插件，让 Agent 在授权下执行只读查询，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness assistant reports a persona voice, with side-by-side original text, optional process info, and an isolated work prompt.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的助手汇报换上人格化口吻，支持原文对照、可选过程运行信息，工作提示词保持独立。

description.en: DSH plugin for the full STM32 workflow: environment detection, .ico transactions, project generation, compiling, flashing, and debugging.
description.zh: DSH插件：覆盖STM32全流程，包括环境探测、.ico事务、工程生成、编译、烧录与调试。

description.en: Local-first memory nebula for DeepSeek Harness with a memory graph, recall, path finding, hygiene and snapshots.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先记忆星云，提供记忆图谱、召回、路径查找、清理与快照。

description.en: Local cross-platform content recommendation agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with UI tab and Agent Bridge tools.
description.zh: 本地跨平台个性化内容推荐 Agent 的 DSH 插件，在界面加第四栏并提供 22 个 Agent Bridge 工具。

description.en: Cross-session agent communication plugin for DeepSeek Harness: lets agent sessions message each other.
description.zh: 跨会话 Agent 通信插件，让同一进程内不同 Agent 会话之间互相收发消息。

description.en: AI agent skill pack for Chinese traditional wisdom (BaZi, Zi Wei, I Ching, Feng Shui, TCM) with local engine and dashboard.
description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供八字、紫微、六爻、梅花、奇门、风水、五运六气与体质分析的传统智慧技能包，含本地确定性引擎和可视化面板，可用 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: File-upload plugin with drag-and-drop, content sniffing, document-to-Markdown conversion, and read_document tool.
description.zh: dsh 文件上传插件：支持拖拽或回形针上传、内容嗅探、用 MarkItDown 把文档转成 Markdown，并提供 read_document 工具。

description.en: Multi-provider web search plugin with zero-key direct search, free-tier APIs, auto-fallback, and GUI settings.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多供应商网页搜索插件，支持免密钥直连必应/百度、Tavily/Brave/Serper/博查免费额度接口、SearXNG 令牌认证、自动故障回退，并内置网页设置界面。

description.en: Local HTTP API letting other agents control DeepSeek Harness sessions via official ApiProxy routes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 HTTP API，让其他智能体通过官方 ApiProxy 路由控制 DSH 会话。

description.en: DSH Material Design 3 × Fluent 2 theme plugin with dynamic color, frosted glass, voiceprint, dock shell, and embedded browser UI.
description.zh: DSH 主题插件，提供 Material 3 动态取色、壁纸磨砂玻璃材质、声纹可视化、dock shell 与嵌入式浏览器界面。

description.en: Enables DeepSeek Harness to directly control local Abaqus/CAE via 21 native tools covering the full FEA modeling chain.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 21 个原生工具直接操控本机 Abaqus/CAE，覆盖几何、材料、网格、接触、分析步、载荷、边界、作业与 ODB 的完整建模链，经 socket 桥接直连，不走 MCP。

description.en: A fully local, free AI short-video/animation canvas studio built on DeepSeek Harness that generates images and videos via local ComfyUI.
description.zh: 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的本地免费 AI 短视频与动画画布工作台，通过本地 ComfyUI 生成图像和视频。

description.en: Read-only MCP server exposing DSH plugin certification registry with grades, snapshot dates, and five-dimension evidence.
description.zh: 只读 MCP 服务器，公开 DSH 插件认证注册库，含等级、快照日期和五维证据。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI that rewrites composer drafts into structured prompts with preview and undo.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness Web GUI的一键提示词增强插件，将草稿重写为结构化提示词，支持预览、回填和撤销。

description.en: DeepTutor bridge for dsh providing learning capabilities, knowledge bases, and note archiving tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 DeepTutor 桥接，接入学习能力、知识库与笔记归档工具。

description.en: Integrates the Qianxing Sandbox knowledge base into DeepSeek Harness for direct Q&A and document retrieval.
description.zh: 将千星沙箱（原神千星奇域）知识库接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持直接问答和文档检索。

description.en: Provides a terminal-based user interface mode for DeepSeek Harness, built on a vendored fork of pi-tui.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 pi-tui 内置分支构建的第三方终端界面模式

description.en: Ports DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav) as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek 官方网页版右侧聊天导航栏（ScrollNav）1:1 移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件

description.en: Academic writing guard that detects AI-style writing, revision residue, and defensive writing in manuscripts with humanize guidance.
description.zh: DSH 论文写作守卫：检测文稿中的 AI 文风、修改残留与防御性写作，提供人化改写指导，并在写入论文文件时通过 writing_audit 与 writing_rules 自动审查。

description.en: Adds 38 academic research tools for searching and retrieving papers, citations and figures across major scholarly databases.
description.zh: 提供38个原生学术工具，可在Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv等主要学术数据库中搜索和获取论文、引用与图表。

description.en: Safe auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness using deterministic rules and LLM review without ever granting full access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动审批：在 workspace-write 沙箱上叠加确定性规则和 LLM 审查，自动模式不放宽沙箱权限。

description.en: PII masking middleware that swaps names, phones, emails, IDs, cards, keys and addresses for placeholders before they reach the model, then restores them on display.
description.zh: PII 脱敏中间件：在请求到达模型前将姓名、电话、邮箱、证件号、银行卡、密钥和地址替换为占位符，并在展示层还原。

description.en: Local music player plugin that scans a folder and streams audio via HTTP Range with a browser playback panel.
description.zh: 扫描本地音乐文件夹，通过 HTTP Range 流式传输音频，并提供浏览器播放面板。

description.en: Bridges Codebase Memory MCP code knowledge graph into DSH via official DSH MCP client.
description.zh: 通过官方 DSH MCP 客户端把 Codebase Memory MCP 的代码知识图谱接入 DSH。

description.en: A Cursor-style AI code editor plugin for DSH with file tree, multi-tab editing, syntax highlighting, and an embedded AI input box.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 的 Cursor 风格 AI 代码编辑器插件，提供文件树、多标签编辑、语法高亮和内嵌 AI 输入框。

description.en: Routes all DSH runtime traffic (model requests, web search/fetch, spawned tools) through the Windows system proxy or a custom address, with a one-click header toggle.
description.zh: 将 DSH 全部运行时流量（模型请求、web search/fetch、spawned 工具）统一路由到 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址，并支持对话头部一键切换。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime for DeepSeek Harness, bundling Playwright and OpenCLI to expose a browser service and interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自包含浏览器运行时，内置 Playwright（Chromium）和 OpenCLI 依赖，开放浏览器服务与交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: Ocean-themed blue whale UI plugin with fish, bubbles, mascot, and brand replacement for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供海洋蓝鲸主题界面，包含海洋配色、鱼群、气泡、吉祥物，并替换品牌元素。

description.en: Renders streaming Markdown in the DSH Web UI with Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, and a safe fallback renderer.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供流式 Markdown 渲染，支持 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 数学公式和安全回退渲染器。

description.en: Multi-provider web search & fetch plugin for DeepSeek Harness with fallback and settings UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多提供商网页搜索与抓取，支持 Tavily、Exa、Firecrawl、Brave、You.com、Jina 和 SearXNG，带故障回退和原生设置界面。

description.en: Runtime-agnostic Rust port of Cordis plugin framework with DI, lifecycle effects, events, and logging.
description.zh: Cordis 插件框架的 Rust 移植，运行时无关，提供作用域依赖注入、生命周期效应管理、事件与结构化日志，无第三方依赖。

description.en: Cross-platform native desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot, screen reading, clicking, typing, scrolling, hotkeys and app launch, all approval-gated.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨平台原生桌面控制：截屏、读屏、点击、输入、滚动、快捷键与启动应用，均需审批。

description.en: OpenTelemetry and Langfuse exporter for DeepSeek Harness observability, with span tracing, metrics, and buffered async export.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 OpenTelemetry 和 Langfuse 可观测性导出，记录轮次、步骤、工具与 LLM span 及 token 和成本指标，脱敏捕获提示与补全，支持异步批量、有界离线缓冲和退避重试。

description.en: Pauses the agent before its next model request to allow human review and insertion, then resumes with Enter.
description.zh: 在 agent 发起下一次模型请求前暂停，供人工审核和插话，按回车放行。

description.en: Portable AI image-retouching and video-editing skill pack for DeepSeek Harness, covering matting, inpainting, compositing, batch exports and timeline editing.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的便携式 AI 图像修图与视频剪辑技能包，涵盖抠图、修复、合成、批量导出与时间线剪辑。

description.en: Shows your active Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, or DeepSeek Harness work as Discord Rich Presence via one local service.
description.zh: 通过一个本地服务，将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 或 DeepSeek Harness 的当前工作状态显示为 Discord Rich Presence。

description.en: DSH tool manager that toggles and groups tools per Agent Preset and loads low-frequency tools on demand to cut context usage.
description.zh: DSH 工具管理插件：按 Agent Preset 开关与分组工具，并像 Skill 一样按需加载低频工具，减少上下文占用。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness with a SQLite provider, memory tool and frozen snapshot injection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供有界、分层、需审批且可审计的跨会话记忆，含零依赖 SQLite 提供者、记忆工具与冻结快照注入。

description.en: Adds terminal-style input history, draft stashing, and Esc recovery to the DeepSeek Harness web composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框添加终端式历史记录：方向键优先从行首边缘浏览、草稿暂存与精确恢复、Esc 找回。

description.en: Settings UI for the Roblox Studio MCP bridge that lists connected Studio instances, lets you pick the active one, and shares it with agents as runtime context.
