description.en: Archives original pre-compaction context locally with pointer summaries and time-weighted keyword/date recall.
description.zh: 在上下文压缩前将原文归档到本地，生成指针摘要，并支持按关键词或日期加权召回。

description.en: Connects ExoMind's server-side knowledge flywheel to DeepSeek Harness, giving agents search, entity lookup and deep Q&A over your personal knowledge base.
description.zh: 把 ExoMind 知识飞轮接入 DeepSeek Harness,为 agent 提供检索、实体查询与深度问答三个工具,直接调用个人知识库。

description.en: Aggregates 30k+ DSH plugins from dshmarket, plugin shops, official lists and npm into one ranked, de-noised leaderboard with AI picks and one-click install.
description.zh: 把 dshmarket、插件商店、官方与 npm 的 3 万多个 DSH 插件汇总成一个去噪排名榜，提供 AI 精选与一键安装。

description.en: Astrophotography planner ranking 18 celestial and deep-sky targets across 173 sites nationwide using light pollution, moon phase, weather and 3D sky simulation.
description.zh: 星野计划：按18类天象与深空目标、全国173个站点，结合光污染、月相、星历与天气推荐排序，并提供3D天球模拟。

description.en: GUI-based skill pool for DSH: import skills from files, ZIP, GitHub or GitLab, group them by repo, and control which agent modes and workspaces load each skill.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的技能池插件：从文件、ZIP、GitHub 或 GitLab 导入技能，按仓库分组管理，并通过图形界面指定每个技能在哪些 Agent 模式和空间生效，无需配置文件。

description.en: Community-maintained WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI model provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness, derived from corrinehu's MIT-licensed connector.
description.zh: 社区维护的 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 模型提供方插件，用于 DeepSeek Harness，源自 corrinehu 的 MIT 许可连接器。

description.en: A language-practice page for DeepSeek Harness with a daily plan, review cards, a speaking recorder with speech analysis, writing answers and progress tracking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的语言练习页面，包含今日计划、复习卡片、带语音分析的朗读录音、写作作答和进度追踪。

description.en: Generates images from chat by calling local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with status, generate and queue actions.
description.zh: 在聊天中调用本地或局域网 ComfyUI 工作节点生成图片，支持状态查询、生成和队列操作。

description.en: Optional DSH Web profile bundle offering six selectable wallpaper themes with palettes, previews, gold accents, glass surfaces, and a licensed display font.
description.zh: 可选的 DSH Web 配置包，提供六种可选壁纸主题，含配色、预览、金色点缀、玻璃质感与授权显示字体。

description.en: Adds a Tower mode to DeepSeek Harness for running multi-agent missions with worktree isolation and review-gated merges under human control.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Tower 模式，支持多智能体任务、工作树隔离和人工把关的评审合并。

description.en: AI-native workbench turning Feishu requirement/task tables into checklists, kanban boards and progress tracking, with an expert AI team running analysis, dev, review and QA.
description.zh: AI 原生工作台：把飞书需求/任务表转成汇总清单、看板和进度，并由专家团 AI 完成需求分析、开发、评审到 QA 全流程。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with per-user conversation isolation and user management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供多用户登录网关，包含登录拦截、按用户隔离会话以及界面内用户管理。

description.en: Persistent PowerShell (pwsh_run) session tool for DeepSeek Harness, plus a C shim giving the bash tool a real write boundary under WSL.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 PowerShell 会话工具（pwsh_run），并附带 C shim 在 WSL 下为 bash 工具建立真正的写入边界。

description.en: Embeds the real chat.deepseek.com web app in a DSH sidebar, binding one DeepSeek conversation per session and quoting messages into its composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中嵌入真实的 chat.deepseek.com 网页应用，为每个 DSH 会话绑定一个 DeepSeek 对话，并可将选中消息以引用块推送到输入框。

description.en: Shows Codex-style ghost next-step prompt suggestions in the composer when an agent finishes a turn, ready to send as-is.
description.zh: 当智能体完成一轮回复时，在输入框中以幽灵文本形式预览可直接发送的下一步提示建议。

description.en: DSH plugin that injects Chinese behavior standards via three layers and provides Web UI to edit prompt.md presets.
description.zh: DSH 插件：简体中文行为规范三层注入（常驻层 + prompt 技能 + anchored preset 锚定注入）+ Web UI 编辑 prompt.md

description.en: macOS screen saver that keeps AI coding agents running while you step away, with Touch ID unlock, no sleep, lid-closed awake and live session themes.
description.zh: macOS 屏保，让你离开时 AI 编程代理持续运行，支持 Touch ID 解锁、不休眠、合盖唤醒和实时会话主题。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy (global & China) models into DeepSeek Harness via one settings card with separate providers, credentials and live model catalog.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 国际版/国内版模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，用一张设置卡片分别管理两套 provider、凭证与实时模型目录。

description.en: Bundles multiple DSH plugins into one .dshpack for one-step install, with sensitive-info scanning, integrity and compatibility checks.
description.zh: 把多个 DSH 插件打成 .dshpack 一次装好，打包强制查敏感信息与风险代码，安装前校验完整性与兼容性。

description.en: Injects selected notes from a designated notes folder into every session at startup, with a starter folder and files created automatically.
description.zh: 每次会话开始时自动从指定笔记文件夹读取并注入若干笔记，默认建好文件夹和起始文件，开箱即用。

description.en: A sidebar credential vault for DeepSeek Harness that stores accounts, passwords and API keys behind an access lock, with an agent read tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏凭据保险库，安全保存账号、密码和 API 密钥，带访问锁与智能体读取工具。

description.en: Groups the DSH session sidebar by time (today, yesterday, this week, earlier) and adds status tabs for running, waiting and unread sessions.
description.zh: 按时间（今天、昨天、本周、更早）对 DSH 会话侧边栏分组，并增加运行中、等待、未读的状态标签页。

description.en: Shows live ETA, actual elapsed time, token budgets and reference costs beside DeepSeek Harness token stats, calibrated locally.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 统计旁显示剩余时间、实际用时、Token 预算与费用参考，并随本地路由表现持续校准。

description.en: Agent-driven infinite canvas for DSH that generates images, video and audio on node graphs, with export plus a zero-dependency local MCP bridge, skills and a node plugin market.
description.zh: Agent 驱动的 DSH 无限画布插件，在节点画布上生成图片、视频与音频并导出，内置零依赖本地 MCP 桥、技能系统与节点插件市场。

description.en: A coding-agent skill that designs web pages as one validated HTML file, fine-tuned on a local canvas with no install, server, or account.
description.zh: 一个编码代理技能：用单个经过校验的 HTML 文件设计网页，并在本地画布上微调，无需安装、服务器或账号。

description.en: DSH plugin bundling an embedded mihomo proxy core: paste a subscription link and all DSH outbound traffic is routed through it.
description.zh: DSH 插件内置 mihomo 内核：粘贴订阅链接即可启动代理，并将 DSH 的出站流量全部经由其转发。

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversation history into DeepSeek Harness as sessions, allowing continuation.
description.zh: 将 chat.deepseek.com 的网页对话历史导入 DeepSeek Harness 作为会话，以便继续对话。

description.en: Meters token and cost usage per model, session and day, enforces budget caps with threshold alerts, and adds carbon and latency insights.
description.zh: 按模型、会话和日期统计 token 与费用，支持预算上限与阈值告警，并提供碳足迹估算和延迟基准。

description.en: Orchestrates a multi-agent OpenSpec implementation pipeline with dev, review and quality-check stages run in an isolated worktree.
description.zh: 为 OpenSpec 实施阶段编排多 Agent 流水线，开发与审核分工，隔离 worktree 中推进并强制质量审查。

description.en: Compresses bash/PowerShell output with the local rtk CLI before it reaches the model, plus a settings card reporting token savings.
description.zh: 在输出到达模型前，使用本地 rtk CLI 压缩 bash/PowerShell 命令输出，并提供显示节省量的设置卡片。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 18 computer_* tools, Set-of-Marks grounding, approval modes, JSONL audit, and a human brake.
description.zh: Windows 桌面计算机使用插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 18 个 computer_* 工具、Set-of-Marks 定位、审批模式、JSONL 审计和人工刹车。

description.en: A conversation efficiency plugin for DeepSeek Harness featuring timeline navigation, favorites, export, prompt library, and notes.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话效率插件，提供时间轴导航、收藏文件夹、对话导出、提示词库和闪记功能。

description.en: Exports dsh agent sessions as OpenTelemetry trace trees to Langfuse's OTLP endpoint for observability.
description.zh: 将 dsh 智能体会话以 OpenTelemetry 追踪树（GenAI 语义约定）导出到 Langfuse 的 OTLP 端点，用于可观测性。

description.en: Right-sidebar plugin that browses the current session's chat history and branch relationships with jump, filter, pin, drag-sort and archive views.
description.zh: 右侧栏插件：浏览当前会话的聊天记录与分支关系，支持跳转、过滤、置顶、拖拽排序和归档展示。

description.en: Adds a Hermes-style tabbed multi-pane workspace to the DSH main area, letting you drag sessions into up to four side-by-side columns.
description.zh: 为 DSH 主区域添加 Hermes 风格的多窗格标签工作区，可拖入会话并拆分为最多四列，每个窗格保留完整对话。

description.en: A heartbeat plugin that lets the DSH agent wake on a rhythm, keep memory and user profiles, and decide when to speak up.
description.zh: 心跳插件：让 DSH agent 按节律醒来，维护记忆与画像，并按分寸决定是否开口。

description.en: A context-metering dispatcher for DeepSeek Harness that routes every task into its own lane.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供上下文计量与调度的插件，让每个任务各归其道。

description.en: Standalone rescue plugin that classifies crashes, runs pre-flight checks, enables safe mode, snapshots manifests and watches for crashes at zero cost.
description.zh: 独立救援插件：崩溃分类、启动前检查、安全模式、清单快照，以及零成本的事件驱动崩溃监视器。

description.en: Native scene-based agents for DeepSeek Harness with bilingual management, explicit model policy and scoped tool access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生场景智能体，具备双语管理、显式模型策略与受限工具权限。

description.en: Process-level outbound proxy for DSH based on a local mihomo kernel, with SSRF protection, kernel SHA256 verification and subscription credential masking.
description.zh: 基于本地 mihomo 内核的 DSH 进程级出站代理插件，具备 SSRF 防护、内核 SHA256 校验与订阅凭据脱敏。

description.en: Screenshot capture plugin with clipboard watcher, floating window, OCR, and Obsidian note organization.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供截图捕获：监听剪贴板并弹系统悬浮窗，可加批注和要点、复制或保存文档与图片，调用通义千问即时 OCR，并按天合并进 Obsidian、晚间由 AI 整理。

description.en: Adds Ollama Cloud as an LLM provider inside DeepSeek Harness (dsh), so the harness can use hosted Ollama models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）添加 Ollama Cloud 作为 LLM 提供方，让 harness 可使用托管的 Ollama 模型。

description.en: Deterministic data profiling, cleaning, and verification for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性的数据剖析、清洗与校验功能。

description.en: Browser-side visual feedback tool for design review: click UI elements, comment, tweak CSS live, and send annotated screenshots to your agent.
description.zh: 面向设计评审的浏览器可视化反馈工具：点击界面元素、添加评论、实时调整 CSS，并把带标注的截图发送给智能体。

description.en: DSH plugin that compresses conversation context in layers (L0→L1→L2→L3), keeping older content at coarser resolution but never deleting it.
description.zh: DSH 分层上下文压缩插件：原文按 L1→L2→L3 逐层降分辨率，越旧越粗但从不删除。

description.en: Adds a voice-first session loop with speech-to-text and text-to-speech to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加语音对话循环：麦克风按钮支持浏览器或本地语音转文字（Web Speech、FunASR、whisper.cpp），speak 工具用浏览器、edge-tts 或 piper 朗读回复，支持事件播报静音和说话打断。

description.en: Layered project memory for DeepSeek Harness with process logs, archives, snapshots, context cleanup/restore, knowledge search and risk-reviewed decisions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层项目记忆插件，包含过程日志、归档、快照、上下文清理与恢复、知识检索和风险评审决策。

description.en: Builds a PPT workspace on DeepSeek Harness: generates, revises, or summarizes presentations from natural language, with quality gates and templates.
description.zh: 在DeepSeek Harness上构建PPT工作区：通过自然语言生成、修改、总结演示文稿，并带质量校验和模板支持。

description.en: Schedules cron jobs that run shell commands and wake an agent only when a gate condition asks for it.
description.zh: 定时运行 shell 命令的 cron 任务插件，仅在门控条件触发时才唤醒智能体。

description.en: Read-only performance diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness sessions: load timing, spill hits, compaction, context-injection volume, and LLM cache hit rate via /fast command and fast_report tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供只读性能诊断，通过 /fast 命令和 fast_report 工具查看会话加载耗时、spill 命中次数、压缩次数与触发原因、上下文注入量及 LLM 缓存命中率。

description.en: Unified image-generation router with config-driven engine routing, fallback, attachments, quotas, and settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的 image_generate 图像生成工具，可按配置路由到 OpenAI Images、智谱 CogView 等兼容接口，支持故障自动回退、会话配额统计、附件持久化保存及插件设置面板。

description.en: Adds ordered and unordered list editing to the DSH composer with auto numbering, marker-aware caret moves and undoable AI prompt polish.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添有序/无序列表编辑：自动编号、标记感知光标移动、空行编排及可撤销的 AI 提示词优化。

description.en: Connects external Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agents to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) via an adapter plugin.
description.zh: 将外部 Agent Client Protocol 代理通过适配器插件接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: In-page task notifications for DeepSeek Harness with toasts, bell history, WebAudio cue, and flashing tab title.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供页面内任务通知：弹窗提示、铃铛历史、WebAudio 提示音和标签页标题闪烁。

description.en: Full-screen animated startup screen for DeepSeek Harness, with a built-in library of videos, wallpapers and audio.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全屏动画启动画面，内置视频、壁纸和音频素材库。

description.en: Adds a visual Grok-powered web search to DeepSeek Harness with automatic fallback to Tavily, Exa, TinyFish and Firecrawl.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入可视化 Grok 主搜索，并在失败时自动回退到 Tavily、Exa、TinyFish 和 Firecrawl。

description.en: A floating-island style skin for DeepSeek Harness with rounded panels, a persistent left nav, and a unified home/account/settings look.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的浮岛式界面皮肤：圆角面板、常驻左侧导航栏，以及统一的首页、账号与设置外观。

description.en: DSH plugin that keeps OpenCode Zen and Go free-tier models working via session affinity, gateway origin headers, and tool-schema fallback.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过会话粘性、网关来源请求头和工具 schema 回退，让 OpenCode Zen 与 Go 免费模型持续可用。

description.en: Governance plugin where a cloud planner delegates coding to a sandboxed local worker with hash-bound, fail-closed promotion checks.
description.zh: 一种治理插件：云端规划器把编码委派给受限的本地执行器，并以哈希绑定、失败即关闭的校验控制产出提升。

description.en: Turns any source text into an AI knowledge graph with facts, inferences, concepts, definitions, examples, counter-examples, rules, and two-way text linking.
description.zh: 把任意源文本转为 AI 知识图谱，提取事实、推论、概念、定义、示例、反例和规则，并支持图谱与原文双向链接。

description.en: Sign in and manage accounts across multiple AI coding providers, with multi-account pools and silent credential refresh.
description.zh: 登录并管理多个 AI 编码服务商账号，支持多账号池与静默凭证刷新。

description.en: Kanban task board plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with a sidebar entry, five columns, real task execution via DSH sessions, and host-side persistence with cross-device real-time sync.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的任务看板插件，提供侧边栏入口与五列看板，任务通过 DSH 会话真实执行，并在 host 端持久化、跨设备实时同步。

description.en: Sign in to Kimi, Grok, Antigravity and GLM subscriptions via OAuth so DSH can use them as LLM providers without API keys.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 Kimi、Grok、Antigravity 和 GLM 订阅账号，让 DSH 无需 API Key 即可将其作为 LLM 提供方使用。

description.en: A git history graph and operations panel for the dsh web IDE, ported from vscode-git-graph.
description.zh: 为dsh Web IDE提供的Git历史图与操作面板，移植自vscode-git-graph。

description.en: A tamagotchi-style pig pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness and the desktop that grows, learns, works, fishes, collects and supports custom skins.
description.zh: 一只住在 DeepSeek Harness 里、也能独立在桌面运行的养成小猪：会长大、上学、打工、钓鱼、收集图鉴并支持自定义皮肤。

description.en: Loads Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as DSH Web GUI backgrounds; renders scene wallpapers via wasm, plays video/web wallpapers.
description.zh: 从本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库加载壁纸作为 DSH Web GUI 背景，用 wasm 渲染 scene 壁纸，并播放视频和 web 壁纸。

description.en: VSCode-like source control page in the DSH Web GUI sidebar showing the current workspace's repos, commit graph, changes, and commit box.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 侧栏提供类 VSCode 源代码管理页，展示当前工作区的仓库、提交图、变更列表与提交框。

description.en: Sidebar panel showing per-key token, cost and cache-hit usage, yearly heatmap, project/session stats and balance, fully local and read-only.
description.zh: 侧边栏用量面板：按通道展示 Token、成本、缓存命中率、年度热力图、项目/会话用量与余额快照，纯本地只读。

description.en: Evaluates and observes AI prompts, RAG, agents, skills, and workflows with evidence-backed metrics.
description.zh: 对提示词、RAG、技能、智能体和工作流进行有证据支撑的评测与可观测性度量。

description.en: Shared Plain-Markdown memory for coding agents in Obsidian, accessed over MCP with citations and past-session import.
description.zh: 在 Obsidian 中为编码智能体提供共享的纯 Markdown 记忆，通过 MCP 访问并支持来源引用与历史会话导入。

description.en: Adds session deep links, full markdown/JSON session export, and approval-gated cross-session messaging with pairing to dsh.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供会话深链、完整 Markdown/JSON 会话导出，以及经批准并需配对的跨会话消息传递。

description.en: Adds a readable one-page session layout, adjustable frosted-glass skins and wallpapers, plus smoother long-session scrolling to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加阅读页排版、可调磨砂皮肤、壁纸与长会话流畅滚动，不替换宿主原有功能。

description.en: macOS notch / Windows Fluent dynamic-island overlay showing DeepSeek Harness agent thinking, tool calls, approvals and parallel subagents live.
description.zh: 兼容 macOS 刘海与 Windows Fluent 的灵动岛插件，实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 智能体思考、工具调用、待审批与子代理并行状态。

description.en: Local BM25 auto-recall, write guard, static doctor, and memory panel for an Engramory markdown store, with no network or daemon.
description.zh: 为 Engramory Markdown 存储提供本地 BM25 自动召回、写入保护、静态诊断和记忆面板，无需网络或守护进程。

description.en: Adds a custom CSS editor under Settings → General → Appearance in the DSH Web GUI, with DevTools-style completion, validation and rule panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的设置 → 通用 → 外观下方增加自定义 CSS 编辑器，具备补全、校验与规则面板等 DevTools 风格体验。

description.en: Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing token/cache analytics, model/provider/workspace breakdown, DeepSeek balance, heatmap, and CSV export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量看板，提供 token/缓存分析、模型/供应商/工作区统计、余额、热力图和 CSV 导出。

description.en: DSH sidebar tab showing a stock market dashboard with quote strips, intraday charts, watchlists, portfolio P&L, A-share boards and read-only agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏行情面板：行情条、分时图、自选股、持仓盈亏、A股板块与只读 Agent 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin providing an on-demand executor/advisor workflow with ask_advisor, review gates, usage ledger, and privacy tiers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供按需的执行者/顾问工作流，包含 ask_advisor、审查关卡、用量账本和隐私层级。

description.en: Takes over the DSH sidebar workspace area to group projects frontend-side and injects each project's doc, format spec and repo links into sessions.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 侧栏工作区，把项目分组变为纯前端归属，并将项目文档、格式规范与关联仓库链接注入会话。

description.en: Adds a Study Plan tab to DSH sessions for AI-generated daily plans, exercises, and local check-in progress tracking.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话中新增「学习计划」标签页，展示对话生成的每日计划、课后题与本地打卡进度。

description.en: Read-only debugging toolkit that lets a DSH agent inspect and troubleshoot its own running runtime instance.
description.zh: 只读调试工具包，让 DSH Agent 检查并排查自身运行时问题。

description.en: Desktop sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness to quickly view ongoing gacha banners and event dates for 11 mobile games, with auto-refresh.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness桌面端侧边栏插件，快速查看11款主流二游当期卡池与活动时间，支持联网自动刷新。

description.en: DSH plugin that manages CLIProxyAPI accounts (balance, check-in, switching) and auto-registers four channels of chat models, starting/stopping with DSH.
description.zh: DSH 插件：管理 CLIProxyAPI 账号（余额、签到、切换），自动注册四个渠道的对话模型，并随 DSH 启停。

description.en: Standalone DSH bundle adding self-evolution to dsh, with inspect→propose→trial→measure→revert workflows, canary promotion and rollback.
description.zh: 独立 DSH bundle，为 dsh 提供自我进化能力：inspect→propose→trial→measure→revert 流程、canary 晋升与回滚。

description.en: Open and drive every dsh on your tailnet from any dsh, with a complete phone-optimized layout.
description.zh: 在任意 dsh 上打开并操控 tailnet 中的所有 dsh，并提供完整的手机端布局。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine gives AI persistent memory of all past conversations and proactively follows up with you.
description.zh: 为 AI 提供持久记忆，保存全部过往对话内容，并能主动向你跟进。

description.en: DSH plugin that auto-fills model metadata (reasoning, context, tokens, image input) for custom providers using models.dev data.
description.zh: DSH插件：为自定义提供商模型自动填充推理级别、上下文、输出上限与图片模态等元数据，数据来自models.dev。

description.en: LAN mesh plugin for DSH: auto-discovers DSH instances on the same subnet and lets you dispatch tasks to peer agents across machines.
description.zh: DSH 局域网 Mesh 插件：自动发现同网段的 DSH 实例，侧栏显示各机在线状态，并可跨机双向把任务派给对端 agent 执行。

description.en: Code-review plugin for DeepSeek Harness × Alibaba OpenCodeReview: stay quiet by default, run a review via one button or a single phrase, and get per-line file:line findings with severity.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness × 阿里 OpenCodeReview 代码评审插件：默认不打扰，一个按钮或一句话即可跑评审，结果按 文件:行 [严重级别] 逐条列出。

description.en: A project ledger memory plugin for DSH that shares one engineering progress record across conversations and models, keeping long runs accurate and traceable.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供工程化项目台账记忆：同一项目跨对话、跨模型共用一份进度记忆，让超长输入输出下的记忆保持准确、可回溯与可延续。

description.en: Client-side performance HUD tracking FPS, long tasks, per-plugin callback rates, DOM/heap and event-loop RTT, with JSON export.
description.zh: 纯客户端性能 HUD：监控帧率、长任务、插件回调速率与耗时、DOM/堆内存及事件循环 RTT，并支持一键导出 JSON。

description.en: Material 3 Expressive mobile web UI plugin for DSH that switches appearance per device.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Material 3 Expressive 移动端 Web UI，并可按设备切换。

description.en: DSH plugin that rewrites your input draft in a chosen character card's voice using the session's model, then sends or lets you review it.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件：选择角色卡后，用当前会话模型把草稿改写成该角色口吻，可直接发送或先人工审查。

description.en: Live2D companion for DSH with realtime TTS voice, continuous speech input, subtitle translation and a multi-model catalog.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Live2D 虚拟形象伴侣，支持实时语音合成、连续语音输入、字幕翻译与多模型目录。

description.en: A 3D hardware sandbox for DSH: assemble parts, wire them up, and run your project's own code against virtual hardware.
description.zh: DSH 的 3D 硬件沙盒：装配元件、接线，并在虚拟硬件上运行你自己的项目代码。

description.en: A DingTalk digital-employee plugin integrating group chat with DeepSeek Harness for persistent AI agents.
description.zh: 基于DeepSeek Harness的钉钉群聊常驻数字员工插件，实现多Agent协作与任务自动化。

description.en: DSH plugin porting thincoder self-discipline suite with advisor convergent review, engineering mode, escalation, and consult.
description.zh: 将thincoder自律套件移植到DSH，提供顾问聚合审查、工程模式、升级和咨询功能。

description.en: Gives a DSH agent 86 ursim_* tools to drive a Universal Robots arm: joint/Cartesian motion, I/O, registers, RTDE telemetry and URScript.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供 86 个 ursim_* 工具，用自然语言驱动 Universal Robots 机械臂，涵盖运动、I/O、寄存器、RTDE 遥测与 URScript。

description.en: Integrates GitHub CLI into DSH for PR, Issue, Actions CI diagnostics and code review, exposed via agent tools, slash commands and Web UI.
description.zh: 基于 GitHub CLI 为 DSH 提供 PR、Issue、Actions CI 诊断与代码审查工作流，支持 Agent 工具、Slash 指令与 Web UI。

description.en: HanaMesh MOD-04 app-host DSH plugin that provisions and hosts DSH applications with pinned, SHA256-verified dependencies.
description.zh: HanaMesh MOD-04 应用宿主 DSH 插件，按固定版本并经 SHA256 校验的依赖置备并托管 DSH 应用。

description.en: Records HanaMesh activity usage events with signed provenance, consent/withdrawal tracking and bounded storage retention.
description.zh: 记录 HanaMesh 活动使用事件，提供签名溯源、同意/撤回跟踪与受限存储保留。

description.en: Floating desktop chat panel for DeepSeek Harness, giving global-hotkey access to sessions, models and tool approvals on macOS and Windows.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面悬浮聊天面板，通过全局快捷键随时访问会话、模型与工具审批（支持 macOS/Windows）。

description.en: Grok plugin for DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login, fused web/X search, and Imagine image generation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Grok 插件，支持 OAuth 登录，可在主循环中融合网页与 X 搜索，并调用 Imagine 生成图像。

description.en: DSH plugin that forks the session when you type while the agent is busy, answering new commands instantly and injecting the old turn's result back later.
description.zh: DSH 插件：agent 忙时自动分叉会话，你的新指令立刻在新会话中响应，旧会话在后台跑完后把结果回注回来。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness DSH prompt enhancement plugin that optimizes drafts and enhances prompts with one click.
description.zh: DSH 提示词增强插件，可一键优化草稿并增强提示词。

description.en: Generate images and videos inside DSH chat via OpenRouter, with per-conversation models, input images, and background video jobs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天中通过 OpenRouter 生成图片和视频，支持按会话选择模型、输入图片与后台视频任务。

description.en: Liuyao divination plugin: casts hexagrams, computes charts with a rules engine, and has the model interpret them with classical citations.
description.zh: 六爻算卦插件：支持手工与电脑摇卦排盘，规则引擎算出盘面事实，模型依典籍断卦并标注出处。

description.en: Connects your locally logged-in WorkBuddy desktop models into DeepSeek Harness via a local bridge, data console, and native dsh plugin.
description.zh: 通过本地桥、数据控制台和 dsh 原生插件，把本机已登录的 WorkBuddy 桌面端模型接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH bundle that supplies native MSYS2 (UCRT64) bash as the shell backend, forked from dsh-bash-local with a configurable bash path.
description.zh: 为 DSH shell 接缝提供原生 MSYS2 (UCRT64) bash 的插件，基于 dsh-bash-local 分支并可配置 bash 路径。

description.en: Excalidraw-based sketchboard where AI agents inspect and annotate drawings and review proposed edits.
description.zh: 基于 Excalidraw 的草图板，让 AI 智能体查看、标注草图并审阅修改建议。

description.en: Auto-detects technical terms in DSH replies, builds a searchable personal dictionary, and shows inline explanations on hover or click.
description.zh: 在 DSH 回复中自动识别专业术语并建立可搜索词典，悬停或点击即可查看解释。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns a workspace into a live visual-novel stage, rendering Stage DSL with backgrounds, sprites, dialog, choices and line-by-line TTS.
description.zh: DSH 插件把工作区变成实时视觉小说舞台，渲染 Stage DSL，包含背景、立绘、对话、停点选择与逐行 TTS。

description.en: Graph-based goal management plugin for DSH that organizes work into goal boards with a full lifecycle.
description.zh: 基于图的 DSH 目标管理插件，把工作组织成目标看板并覆盖完整生命周期。

description.en: Chat-area UX plugin that improves the interaction experience of the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI, with a glassmorphism style.
description.zh: 优化 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）网页界面聊天区交互体验的插件，带玻璃拟态风格。

description.en: AI-driven partial-wave analysis automation: edits physics configs, runs ctpwa fits, evaluates results, iterates to convergence.
description.zh: AI驱动的分波分析自动化：编辑物理配置，运行ctpwa拟合，评估数值结果并迭代收敛。

description.en: OneBot v11 hub that relays QQ events verbatim to downstream bots while giving the agent a full event timeline, action ledger and 28 onebot_* tools.
description.zh: OneBot v11 中枢，将 QQ 事件原样转发给下游机器人，并为代理提供完整事件时间线、操作账本与 28 个 onebot_* 工具。

description.en: Renders a Gantt chart in the DSH sidebar showing one swimlane per agent teammate, with shared tasks plotted against real session time.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏渲染甘特图，每个智能体队友一条泳道，按真实会话时间展示共享任务。

description.en: DSH plugin that keeps AI agents on-task by anchoring good first-round behavior, watching each step, and pulling the agent back when it drifts.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，通过锚定首轮良好行为、逐步监控并在智能体偏离时将其拉回，防止智能体跑偏任务。

description.en: Reorders the DSH sidebar so top panels and bottom actions form one unified, custom-sortable rail.
description.zh: 将 DSH 侧边栏顶部面板与底部动作合并为一条可自定义排序的统一栏。

description.en: Bridges DeepSeek Harness to external image-generation models, with multiple providers plus primary and fallback model routing, all configured in the Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入外部生图模型的桥接插件：可添加多个服务商，为生图与修图分别配置主用和备用模型，备用自动接管，全部在 Web 界面点击配置。

description.en: Search saved conversation titles and messages across DSH workspaces, plus Ctrl+F / Cmd+F find-in-page inside the current chat.
description.zh: 跨 DSH 工作区搜索已保存的对话标题与消息，并支持在当前聊天内使用 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 页内查找。

description.en: Tracks effort and token usage by date and workspace, with calendar heatmaps, time-of-day analysis and exportable self-contained HTML reports.
description.zh: 按日期与工作区统计工作量与 Token 消耗，提供日历热力图、时段分析与可导出的独立 HTML 报告。

description.en: Orchestrates a user-owned pipeline that syncs DeepSeek web history into a local knowledge base without credentials or its own network.
description.zh: 编排用户自有的 DeepSeek 网页历史记录到本地知识库的同步管线，无需凭据，也不自行联网。

description.en: DSH enhancement plugin adding long-context management, task verification, prompt optimization, code understanding, computer control and four themes.
description.zh: DSH 增强插件，提供长上下文整理、任务验证、提示词优化、代码理解、电脑操作与四套主题。

description.en: Injects one global prompt section enforcing house rules (no check/cross glyphs, light kaomoji) on every DSH agent, preset and subagent.
description.zh: 通过一个全局提示词段落为所有 DSH 智能体、预设与子智能体设定统一规则：不使用对勾/叉号符号，并适度使用颜文字。

description.en: A TUI plugin for DeepSeek Harness focused on self-improvement, where all components are also plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的自改进终端界面（TUI）插件，原名 deepseek-harness-tui，其所有组件本身也是插件。

description.en: Adds aggregate status badges to collapsed sidebar group rows in DSH, showing running, pending-approval and scheduled sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏收起的分组行添加聚合状态徽标，显示进行中、待审批与定时任务数量。

description.en: HanaMesh core identity client plugin: device identity, consent/withdrawal, settings entry, health observation and Uint8Array signing.
description.zh: HanaMesh 核心身份客户端插件，提供设备身份、同意/撤回、设置入口、健康观察与签名能力。

description.en: Restyles DSH's thinking chain like the DeepSeek app: language-matched reasoning, 5-line scroll preview, expandable full reasoning.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的思考链看起来像 DeepSeek 官方 App：思考跟随提问语言，5 行滚动预览，可展开查看完整推理。

description.en: Third-party plugin marketplace and guarded lifecycle manager for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供第三方插件市场，并以带防护的方式管理插件的安装与生命周期

description.en: DSH plugin bundling the kimi-ppt skill to create, edit, clone, and export PPT presentations with fully local export inside DSH.
description.zh: DSH 插件，内置 kimi-ppt 技能，可在 DSH 内创建、编辑、复刻并纯本地导出 PPT 演示文稿。

description.en: Offline vocabulary panel for DeepSeek Harness with a capsule beside the composer and a dedicated sidebar tab.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的离线词汇面板，在输入框旁提供胶囊入口并带侧边栏标签页。

description.en: Adds a toggleable tsundere whale-girl persona paragraph to DSH, giving the assistant a global character voice.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加可开关的傲娇鲸鱼娘全局人格段落，让助手以该角色口吻回应。

description.en: One main chat for DeepSeek Harness that automatically routes conversation history into topic workspaces.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供单一主聊天，并自动将历史记录路由到不同主题工作区。

description.en: Git automation plugin for DSH: scan repos, audit code, and one-click commit/push via tool or HTTP API.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 自动化插件，可扫描仓库，并通过工具或 HTTP API 一键执行 commit 和 push。

description.en: DSH session cost billing plugin showing account balance, peak/off-peak pricing, and per-session spend breakdown in the input bar and sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 会话费用账单插件：展示账号余额、峰谷计价，以及每个会话（含子代理衍生会话）的消耗构成，输入框与侧栏双入口。

description.en: Spanish (Chile) language pack for the DSH web interface, translating 2603 strings via a client plugin with no app patching.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 界面的智利西班牙语语言包，通过客户端插件翻译 2603 条字符串，无需修改应用本身。

description.en: Browser automation middleware where an LLM plans once and local rules plus decision models execute each step reproducibly, even without model weights.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化中间件：LLM 只规划一次，后续由本地规则与决策模型逐步执行，无模型权重也能运行。

description.en: DSH web page capability pack adding VSCode-style in-page terminal, file tree, and skill management.
description.zh: DSH 网页能力插件包，首个能力是 VSCode 风格页内终端，零依赖、零构建。

description.en: Adds an activity pane to DSH showing running, sub, awaiting-response, and recently active sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加活动面板，显示运行中、子会话、等待响应以及最近活跃的会话。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that routes a single URL fragment so the address bar reflects the current conversation or main panel and links open it.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，用单个 URL 片段路由，使地址栏反映当前对话或主面板，并能通过链接打开。

description.en: A ZCode-styled UI skin for DSH Web, adding a redesigned sidebar, workspace session tree, global search, and turn navigation.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 ZCode 风格界面皮肤，包含侧栏、工作区会话树、全局搜索与轮次导航。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns the input box into a structured prompt form, letting users or the model build and send structured prompts.
description.zh: DSH 插件，把输入框变成结构化提示词表单，让用户或模型构建并发送结构化提示词。

description.en: Hierarchical persistent memory for DSH agents, so they remember preferences and project decisions across sessions without mixing projects.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供分层持久记忆，跨会话记住偏好与项目决策，并按项目隔离。

description.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness composer model selector with a grouped, searchable model library for multi-provider setups.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 聊天输入框的模型选择器替换为分组、可搜索的模型库，适合多 Provider 场景。

description.en: Enhances dsh-im by giving every AI agent a home, showing which workspace has agents online, and enabling drag-and-drop relocation.
description.zh: 通过助理和家的概念增强 dsh-im，一览各工作区助理状态并支持拖拽搬家。

description.en: Diagnoses silent plugin conflicts in DeepSeek Harness and gives the exact patch that fixes each one.
description.zh: 诊断 DeepSeek Harness 中插件间的隐性冲突，并给出修复每个冲突的精确补丁。

description.en: Gives DSH plugins custom Chinese display names in the native plugin list, with grouping, collapsible sections and custom tags.
description.zh: 为 DSH 插件列表中的插件设置自定义中文备注名，支持分组、折叠与自定义标签，并直接显示在原生设置页。

description.en: Persistent Computer Use REPL with an embedded browser for DeepSeek Harness, reusing the host runtime without patches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化的 Computer Use REPL 和内嵌浏览器，复用宿主运行时且无需打补丁。

description.en: AWiki identity and messaging plugin with Web UI, draggable launcher, and attachment support.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AWiki 身份与消息收发功能，含 Web 界面、可拖动启动器和附件支持。

description.en: Adds a fixed in-window button to hot-restart DeepSeek Harness with no console windows, plus a self-check that writes a diagnostic report.
description.zh: 在窗口内提供固定按钮，一键零控制台热重启 DeepSeek Harness，并内置自检生成单文件诊断报告。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for diagnosing issues and joint debugging in ROS 2.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ROS 2 插件，用于诊断 ROS 2 中的问题并进行联合调试。

description.en: SSH remote workspaces: browse, read/write files and run commands on remote hosts from DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 SSH 连接远程主机，浏览、读写远程文件并运行远程命令，并显示连接状态点。

description.en: A visual multi-agent workflow orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 一个用于 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的可视化多智能体工作流编排插件。

description.en: Installs a working short-video production pipeline as 19 built-in DSH skills: one entry, one orchestrator, and 17 atomic skills.
description.zh: 把一条真实跑通的短视频生产流水线以内置技能形式装进 DSH：共 19 个技能（1 个入口 + 1 个编排 + 17 个原子）。

description.en: Settings-tab plugin that lets users control which DSH Panel rail entries appear, their order, names, icons, and grouping.
description.zh: 通过设置标签页自定义 DSH 左侧面板栏条目的显示、排序、名称、图标与分组。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DSH agents: four tools write conclusions to a human-readable NDJSON file and recall them on demand.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供跨会话长期记忆：四个工具把结论写入人类可读的 NDJSON 文件，并按需显式召回。

description.en: VSCode-style remote SSH development for DSH with host manager, helper deployment, and transparent remote files, terminal and git.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 VSCode 风格的远程 SSH 开发能力，支持主机管理、助手部署以及透明的远程文件、终端与 Git 操作。

description.en: Core quick-control panel for the DSH web UI: floating/docked panel, extensible switch registry, skin system, zh/en i18n and alert surfaces.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的快捷控制面板核心：悬浮/停靠面板、可扩展开关注册表、皮肤系统、中英文 i18n 与提示浮层。

description.en: AI plugin for electric motor electromagnetic design: L0 millisecond-wide screening, then L1 RMxprt and L2 Motor-CAD verification.
description.zh: 面向电机电磁设计的 AI 插件：L0 毫秒级广筛，再用 L1 RMxprt 与 L2 Motor-CAD 逐级校核。

description.en: Turns one character sheet into game-ready assets using Seedream image gen, MiniMax image-to-video, and local ffmpeg processing.
description.zh: 从一张角色设定图出发，用 Seedream 生图、MiniMax 图生视频，配合本机 ffmpeg 批量生成游戏素材。

description.en: DSH plugin that joins multiple machines into one fleet so you can dispatch work to any, some, or all of them in natural language.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把多台机器接入同一鸭群，用自然语言给「某个/某几个/全部」机器派活。

description.en: Resident cognitive engine for LLM agent runtimes running a six-stage meta-problem lifecycle with ε-δ convergence.
description.zh: 面向 LLM 智能体运行时的常驻认知引擎，提供六阶段问题生命周期与 ε-δ 双判据收敛。

description.en: A project-logic DSH memory system that aggregates and hands over knowledge via handover docs, with hot-reload editable plugin prompts.
description.zh: 基于项目逻辑的 DSH 记忆系统，通过交接文档聚合与交接知识，支持热加载提示词前端编辑。

description.en: Backs up DSH skills, plugins, config, memory and todos into one tar.gz and restores them per-module on a new machine via baseline three-way merge.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的技能、插件、配置、记忆和待办打包成 tar.gz，换机时按模块基于基线做三方合并导入。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness dispatch-mode agent preset and agent-team plugin with 12 teammate roles, shared cache-friendly cards, and structured result reporting.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的调度模式智能体预设与团队插件，提供 12 类队员角色、共享队员卡与结构化汇报能力。

description.en: A-share (China stock) market panel for DSH Web: real-time indices, quotes, watchlist, screening, and 7x24 news.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供 A 股行情面板，含实时指数、个股行情、自选股、选股筛选与 7x24 新闻。

description.en: Provides stable per-agent session IDs for conversations, workspaces, and subagents over a shared MCP connection, enabling context isolation.
description.zh: 为对话、工作区和子代理提供稳定的会话ID，在共享MCP连接上实现上下文隔离。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible proxy and DeepSeek Harness engine that compacts context for local LLMs without breaking the session.
description.zh: 兼容 OpenAI 的代理与 DeepSeek Harness 引擎，为本地模型压缩上下文，触发可靠且不会中断会话。

description.en: Records, indexes, and searches files, tools, environments, knowledge, and work records across workspaces for reuse.
description.zh: 跨工作区互操作库，用于记录、索引和搜索文件、工具、环境、知识和工作记录以便重用。

description.en: Multi-host AI coding CLI that enforces P0 quality gates and harness guardrails across Cursor, Claude Code and DSH.
description.zh: 多宿主 AI 编码 CLI，为 Cursor、Claude Code 和 DSH 提供 P0 质量门禁与 Harness 护栏。

description.en: Workspace-aware direnv support that injects each workspace's .envrc environment into every agent-owned shell command.
description.zh: 工作区感知的 direnv 支持，自动把所在工作区的 .envrc 环境注入每个 agent 拥有的 shell 命令。

description.en: A DSH plugin that lets an agent run Linux commands directly through wsl.exe without scripts.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件，让智能体通过wsl.exe直接运行Linux命令，无需脚本。

description.en: In-app DSH Desktop update center with progress bar, resume, auto-replace the app and restart, plus skills/MCP/agent settings pages.
description.zh: 内置 DSH Desktop 更新中心：带进度条、断点续传、自动替换应用并重启，并新增技能、MCP、智能体与导入设置页。

description.en: DSH desktop watcher plugin that alerts you with system notifications, sounds and title marks when a task needs input or finishes while you're away.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端守望提醒插件：任务需要操作或回复完成时，用系统通知、提示音和标题标记把你唤回。

description.en: A dsh host plugin that drives recurring agent tasks from one definition table, dispatching each due task as an independent session with zero model involvement in scheduling.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 宿主层插件，用一张任务定义表驱动周期性任务，到期即派发为独立会话执行，调度本身不消耗任何模型 token。

description.en: DSH plugin that deletes a session or a single turn through one shared confirmation flow and a consistent set of failure codes.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过统一的确认流程和一致的失败码，删除整个会话或单轮对话。

description.en: Mines human-microbiome functional dark matter, turning target enzymes/EC/reactions into candidate proteins with sequence, structure and literature evidence.
description.zh: 挖掘人体微生物功能暗物质：把目标酶、EC 号或底物-产物反应转化为候选蛋白，并提供序列、结构与文献证据链及可验证实验方案。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness with 42 skills, 33 role cards, 55 MCP tools, graph DAG runtime, team pipelines and a HUD panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层，内置 42 个技能、33 张角色卡、55 个 MCP 工具、图 DAG 运行时、团队流水线与 HUD 面板。

description.en: Adds a sidebar button that restarts the DSH desktop app and reloads the page when it comes back.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部添加一个按钮，用于重启 DSH 桌面应用并在恢复后重新加载页面。

description.en: Local Git workbench plus GitHub Code/Issues/PRs/Actions tabs inside the DSH right sidebar, with commit messages written by your DSH model.
description.zh: 把本地 Git 工作台和 GitHub 的 Code/Issues/PR/Actions 页签装进 DSH 右侧栏，提交信息由 DSH 模型生成。

description.en: Builds, tests, cleans, archives, and runs iOS/macOS Xcode projects with live filterable logs and simulator/USB device log channels.
description.zh: 构建、测试、清理、归档并运行 iOS/macOS Xcode 项目，支持实时可筛选构建日志及模拟器与 USB 设备日志通道。

description.en: Provides bioinformatics and biology analysis tools for DeepSeek Harness using Biopython for sequence and genomics analysis.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Biopython 的序列与基因组分析工具，并用 uv+venv 免安装 Python 环境。

description.en: DSH provider route that auto-selects the best free LLM through a local FreeLLMAPI gateway, with automatic failover and native chunk streaming.
description.zh: DSH 提供商路由，通过本地 FreeLLMAPI 网关自动选择最佳免费模型，支持自动故障转移并以原生分块流式返回。

description.en: Agent bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness using JSON recipes, a cross-platform launcher, recipe wizard, self-test and registry import.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体桥接插件，支持 JSON 配方、跨平台启动器、配方向导、自检与注册表导入。

description.en: Verifies claims in AI coding agents' design docs and refactoring plans using structural and adversarial logic probes.
description.zh: 对 AI 编程助手的设计文档与重构计划进行声明核查，用 7 个结构探针和 7 个对抗探针做逻辑原语验证。

description.en: DSH plugin that displays your DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the left sidebar using native UI.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在左侧边栏底部以原生界面显示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: DSH plugins giving projects persistent context: session archive with mechanical index, memory consolidation, skill autolearn and handoff.
description.zh: DSH 插件为项目提供持久化上下文：带机械索引的会话归档、记忆整合、低频技能自学习与自动交接。

description.en: MCP router and native DeepSeek Harness bundle that provides seven MCP servers using 934 tokens instead of 20,005.
description.zh: MCP 路由器和原生 DeepSeek Harness 捆绑包，以 934 个 token 提供七个 MCP 服务器，而非 20,005 个。

description.en: DSH usage statistics dashboard with token, cost, duration, session aggregation and visualizations.
description.zh: DSH 用量统计面板插件，按 token、费用、时长和会话聚合数据，并提供趋势、热力图和日历视图。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel showing today's token spend, budget progress, cost breakdown by input/output type, and cache savings.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏面板：显示今日 Token 花费、预算进度、成本构成与缓存节省金额。

description.en: Floating capsule in DSH showing GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot quota snapshots and subscription usage details.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮胶囊插件，直观展示 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的额度快照和订阅用量详情。

description.en: Unofficial Simplified-Chinese fork of a tri-agent preset pairing Atlas orchestration with Prometheus planning, packaged for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 非官方简体中文分叉的三智能体预设，结合 Atlas 编排与 Prometheus 规划，打包用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH host plugin that lets you control DeepSeek Harness from your phone: approve tool calls, watch streaming output, answer questions, with E2E encryption.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：用手机远程操作 DeepSeek Harness，审批工具调用、查看流式输出、回答问题，端到端加密。

description.en: Static directory website that automatically collects and categorizes GitHub projects tagged with the dsh-plugin topic.
description.zh: 自动收录 GitHub 上带 dsh-plugin 话题的项目并分类，生成静态目录网站供浏览。

description.en: Maintains long-term instructions in the DSH settings UI and auto-injects them into every subsequent conversation's system prompt.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置界面维护长期指令，并自动注入到之后每次对话的系统提示词中。

description.en: Embeds a persistent stock index bar and draggable quote window in the DSH chat UI, showing real-time quotes, charts and holding P&L.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面嵌入常驻大盘指数栏与可拖动行情悬浮窗，实时显示行情、分时/K线与持仓盈亏。

description.en: Audits DSH disk usage across sessions, attachments and caches, then moves reclaimable files into a restorable quarantine instead of deleting them.
description.zh: 审计 DSH 的会话、附件与缓存占用，并把可清理文件移入可还原的隔离区而非直接删除。

description.en: A shared global todo list kept in one JSON file that both a person and an AI agent can read and write.
description.zh: 一个以单个 JSON 文件保存的全局待办清单，人类和 AI 智能体都能读写。

description.en: Automated transparent ranking/recommendation for DSH plugins by scraping GitHub dsh-plugin topics and scoring them with a public model.
description.zh: 每日抓取 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题仓库，用公开评分模型为 DSH 插件生成排行与推荐，并输出静态站点。

description.en: DSH session manager: archive/restore, AI auto-rename, auto-resume interrupted runs, workspace grouping, full-text search, and log repair.
description.zh: DSH 会话管理增强：归档恢复、AI 自动重命名、中断自动续跑、按工作区分组、全文搜索与损坏日志修复。

description.en: Russian (ru) language pack that localizes the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, installed as a hybrid dsh.bundle + dsh.client plugin.
description.zh: 俄语（ru）语言包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供本地化，以 dsh.bundle + dsh.client 混合插件形式安装。

description.en: Enables DSH to control Universal Robots (UR) robotic arms through natural-language commands via the nUR MCP Server.
description.zh: 让 DSH 通过自然语言直接控制优傲（UR）机械臂，基于自研 nUR MCP Server 逻辑。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin market - browse, search & install dsh-plugin topic plugins
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，可浏览、搜索并安装 dsh-plugin 主题的插件。

description.en: DSH plugin adding web search and Responses V2 context compaction to Sub2API/NewAPI GPT routes.
description.zh: 为 Sub2API 或 NewAPI 的 GPT 路由添加 DSH 网络搜索和 Responses V2 原生上下文压缩

description.en: Peak/valley cross-provider router that runs cheap models off-peak and premium ones at peak to cut API costs.
description.zh: 跨 provider 的峰谷路由插件：谷时用低价模型，峰时切换到高价模型，降低 API 账单。

description.en: Routes DSH's built-in web_search through the WorkBuddy desktop app login session, returning cited cloud search summaries with zero config or API keys.
description.zh: 将 DSH 内置 web_search 接入 WorkBuddy 桌面端登录态，零配置、无需 API Key，返回带引用的云端检索综述。

description.en: Spec-driven service factory and local agent workbench for DSH, with standards vault, service generation, and a web ops console.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的规范驱动服务工厂与本地智能体工作台，提供标准库、服务生成和运维面板。

description.en: oh-my-zsh-style enhancement bundle for DeepSeek Harness: packaged skills, work-rule prompts, Enhance agent preset, guards, work tracking and worktrees.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 oh-my-zsh 风格增强包：内置技能、工作规则提示、Enhance 智能体预设、守卫与交付门禁、工作跟踪与 worktree。

description.en: Japanese language plugin that translates the DSH Web UI into Japanese with friendly fallback fonts.
description.zh: 将 DSH 网页界面翻译为日语的本地化插件，并提供友好的日文回退字体。

description.en: DSH multi-threaded download plugin with built-in aria2 that auto-detects file size to pick the best download strategy across platforms.
description.zh: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2，自动探测文件大小以选择最佳下载策略，支持多平台。

description.en: DSH plugin for WorkBuddy, Qoder and Trae: auto check-in, multi-channel aggregation, in-session model switching and reasoning effort.
description.zh: 面向 WorkBuddy / Qoder / Trae 的 DSH 插件：自动签到、多渠道聚合、会话内切换模型与推理强度。

description.en: Manage skills (SKILL.md) and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel with global/project-level layering and instant apply.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中管理技能（SKILL.md）和 MCP 服务器，支持全局/项目级分层，修改后立即生效。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a MoE4All OpenAI-compatible server, managing local server startup, health checks, and shutdown.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 MoE4All 的 OpenAI 兼容服务器，并管理本地服务的启动、健康检查与关闭。

description.en: DSH plugin that bridges to the official MATLAB MCP server so agents can run MATLAB code, tests, checks and Simulink models.
description.zh: DSH 插件通过官方 MATLAB MCP 服务器让 Agent 执行 MATLAB 代码、测试、静态检查并操作 Simulink 模型。

description.en: Star DSH sessions and workspaces, filter to favourites only, hide the rest, pin with hover metadata, and inherit stars through forks.
description.zh: 收藏 DSH 会话与工作区，仅显示收藏、隐藏未收藏项，支持悬停元数据固定、星标颜色与分支继承。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme plugin offering 10 OKLCH Morandi color schemes plus optional frosted-glass wallpaper overlay.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 主题插件：提供十套 OKLCH 莫兰迪配色，并可选壁纸加磨砂玻璃叠加效果。

description.en: Adds Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth login and model access to DSH with a multi-account pool, 429 rotation and device fingerprinting.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Google Antigravity (agy) 的 OAuth 登录与模型访问，支持多账号池、429 限流轮换与设备指纹。

description.en: Multi-round iterative deep-research plugin that searches 14 platforms, grades source credibility A/B/C/D, cross-verifies claims and flags misinformation.
description.zh: 多轮迭代深度检索插件，覆盖14个平台定向搜索，按A/B/C/D分级来源可信度，交叉验证并识别虚假信息。

description.en: Backs up workspace folders to S3-compatible object storage (RustFS, MinIO, Aliyun OSS, AWS S3) with credentials read only from environment variables.
description.zh: 把工作区文件备份到 S3 兼容对象存储（RustFS、MinIO、阿里云 OSS、AWS S3），凭证只从环境变量读取。

description.en: Turns DSH answers into interactive UI widgets including calculators, charts, forms, simulations and mini-games.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的回答变成可交互界面组件：计算器、图表、表单、模拟器和小游戏。

description.en: A centralized plugin marketplace and self-maintaining registry that scans, verifies, and indexes plugins for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供集中式插件市场与自动维护的注册表，可扫描、验证并索引插件。

description.en: Automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness with a test-case library, bug reports, per-project serial queues, a dev board, and built-in load testing.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自动化测试平台：用例库、缺陷报告、项目串行队列、开发看板与内置压力测试。

description.en: Local-first cross-session memory for DSH: logs each turn, distills entries on demand, and injects relevant memories, all in local SQLite offline.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地优先的跨会话记忆：每轮自动沉淀、按需整理并注入相关记忆，数据全部存于本地 SQLite，不联网。

description.en: Archives each DSH turn as a Run with a background summary, letting the agent recall, search and forget its own execution history.
description.zh: 把每个 turn 归档为一条 Run 并后台生成摘要，让 Agent 通过 recall/forget 回查自己的执行历史。

description.en: Turns an image into a record of numbered marks with coordinate-labelled close-ups and comparison sheets for checking.
description.zh: 将图片转化为带编号标记的记录，并生成带坐标的局部特写与对比图以便核对。

description.en: Cited for DeepSeek Harness searches your documents and answers questions with inline citations via RAG.
description.zh: Cited 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文档检索，并基于 RAG 给出带引用的回答。

description.en: Cross-agent session continuity for DSH: resume and continue work started in Codex, Claude Code, Grok, ZCode and other coding agents.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供跨智能体会话连续性，可接手 Codex、Claude Code、Grok、ZCode 等代理的既有会话继续工作。

description.en: File-state-machine dev process plugin for any repo, with 7 role subagents, gate scripts and a GUI status board.
description.zh: 面向任意仓库的开发流程插件：文件状态机驱动，内置 7 个角色 Subagent、门禁脚本与 GUI 状态看板。

description.en: Selection-scoped explanation sidebar that forks isolated citation threads from DeepSeek Harness conversations for focused Q&A.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中选中文本后，从该对话分叉出独立引用线程，在侧栏内做聚焦问答。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets you enable a proxy per provider in Settings, so only chosen providers route through the proxy while all other traffic stays direct.
description.zh: DSH 插件，可在设置中为每个 provider 单独开启代理，只有选中的 provider 走代理，其余流量保持直连。

description.en: Monorepo plugin family for the DSH Web GUI with a plugin template, dev kit and one-command all-in-one bundle of extra tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的插件家族单体仓库，提供插件模板、开发工具包和一键式全家桶安装包。

description.en: Adds workspace-less (ungrouped) sessions to DeepSeek Harness by temporarily mounting each one so the native input area stays usable.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加未分组会话，通过临时挂载工作区让原生输入区可用，首条消息后自动回到未分组。

description.en: Universal DSH skill adapter that lets you register any GitHub repo with a SKILL.md as a DSH skill via a single command.
description.zh: 装一次即可用一条命令把任意含 SKILL.md 的 GitHub 仓库注册为 DSH skill，无需插件代码或 package.json。

description.en: CLI plugin for DSH that makes it easy to set up AI providers like Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OpenRouter and Hermes Agent.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 CLI 插件，可轻松配置 Codex、Claude、OpenCode、OpenRouter 和 Hermes Agent 等 AI 提供商。

description.en: DSH test assistant that narrows manual test scope from Git diffs, records web/mobile operation tracks and crash logs, and uses AI to generate reproducible bug steps.
description.zh: 基于 Git 差异缩减手工测试范围，录制 Web/移动端操作轨迹与崩溃日志，并用 AI 生成可复现缺陷步骤的 DSH 测试助手插件。

description.en: Loads only basic DSH tools by default and activates the remaining tools on demand through activate_tools.
description.zh: 默认仅加载 DSH 基础工具，其余工具可通过 activate_tools 按需激活，保持工具集精简。

description.en: Ships an AI-assisted large-project development standard for DSH, with a `std check` commit gate and Markdown templates.
description.zh: 提供 AI 辅助大型项目开发规范，并附带可作提交门的 std check 与 Markdown 模板。

description.en: Observe and steer a local OpenAI Codex session from DeepSeek Harness over the Codex app-server JSON-RPC protocol.
description.zh: 通过 Codex app-server 协议，在 DeepSeek Harness 中观察并操控本地 OpenAI Codex 会话。

description.en: Supply-chain-aware updater that installs only pnpm release-age-allowed plugin versions, with snapshots and one-step rollback.
description.zh: 供应链感知的插件更新器：只安装符合 pnpm 发布时长策略的版本，支持快照与一键回滚。

description.en: Continuously logs your local Harness LLM calls — prompts, skills, tool calls, file I/O and web fetches — into readable Markdown per session.
description.zh: 持续记录本地 Harness 调用 LLM 的全过程：提示词、技能加载、工具调用、文件读写与联网抓取，按会话生成易读的 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Browser automation and debugging for DeepSeek Harness: multi-window/tab control, accessibility snapshots, ref actions, console and network capture.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页操作与调试：多窗口/多标签、可访问性快照、ref 操作、控制台与网络采集。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds Zhihu search tools: in-site search, web-wide indexed search, and sourced direct answers via the official Zhihu API.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供知乎站内搜索、全网索引搜索与直答三个工具的插件，基于知乎开放平台官方 API，引用有出处。

description.en: Topic memory for LLM agents: edited topics with question, conclusion, impact, dependencies; local-first, git-traceable, budgeted LLM-free injection.
description.zh: 面向LLM代理的主题记忆：可编辑主题含问题、结论、影响和依赖；本地优先、Git可追溯、预算内免LLM注入。

description.en: Deterministic code security audits for AI coding agents using git history, test coverage, and six-gate claim adjudication.
description.zh: 为 AI 编程代理提供确定性代码安全审计，基于 Git 历史、测试覆盖率和六门声明裁决。

description.en: Zero-dependency static and sandbox smoke detector that verifies and lints DeepSeek Harness plugins across R/K/D/CC layers.
description.zh: 零依赖的静态与沙箱冒烟检测器，按 R/K/D/CC 分层校验和检查 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Host-side DSH control plugin that injects per-trial aeval config, caps budget, and seals evidence into a verifiable bundle descriptor.
description.zh: 宿主侧 DSH 评测控制插件：为 aeval 单次试次注入配置、封顶预算，并密封可校验的证据包。

description.en: Sends a Windows native notification when a DSH task truly finishes, showing session title, result status and last reply summary.
description.zh: 当 DSH 任务真正完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，显示会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复摘要。

description.en: A Codex-like WYSIWYG Markdown editor in the DSH right sidebar that renders documents you edit in place, including table cells.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的类 Codex Markdown 编辑器，文档直接渲染并可就地编辑，包括表格单元格。

description.en: Sidebar DSH widget showing whether DeepSeek API is in off-peak or peak pricing hours, a countdown to the next switch, and the current price list.
description.zh: 侧栏 DSH 插件：显示 DeepSeek API 当前处于空闲还是高峰价格时段、距下次切换的倒计时，以及当前生效价目表。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness, defining a captain plus members with their own prompt, model, reasoning effort, and tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可复用的 Agent Team 预设，包含队长与成员各自的提示词、模型、推理强度和工具配置。

description.en: Shows the brand logo of the model chosen for each sidebar session, updating live from the composer selector with a history fallback.
description.zh: 在侧边栏每个会话中显示所选模型的品牌标识，随输入区模型选择器实时更新，历史会话则回退到最近一次请求。

description.en: Evidence-backed PR contribution advisor for large open source projects.
description.zh: 针对大型开源项目的 PR，基于证据给出提交前改进建议，并内置 PR 知识库。

description.en: Agent preset that plans PM-first, delegates tasks to expert subagents, enforces gated delivery, and pools experience across runs.
description.zh: 专家编排模式预设：PM 先规划，委派专家子代理执行，交付门控并沉淀经验池。

description.en: Manages SSH hosts in DSH, opens remote terminals, browses/edits remote files and Git, and mounts remote dirs as workspaces so agent ops run remotely.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 SSH 主机,打开远程终端,浏览与编辑远程文件和 Git,并把远程目录设为工作区,让 Agent 的操作在远端执行。

description.en: Extensible quick-control panel for DSH Web offering registry switching and a skin manager, usable standalone or with dock-base.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的可扩展快捷控制面板，支持切换注册表与皮肤管理，可独立使用或配合 dock-base。

description.en: Runs dsh command and tool execution inside rootless Podman containers for isolated, containerized workloads.
description.zh: 在无根 Podman 容器中执行 dsh 的命令与工具调用，实现隔离的容器化运行。

description.en: Local SenseVoice speech-to-text voice input for DSH with smart polishing and a correction memory that learns from your edits.
description.zh: DSH 本地 SenseVoice 语音转文字输入，支持智能润色，并能从你的修改中学习纠错记忆。

description.en: Unofficial DSH agent preset plus a Windows beta test bundle for FoloToy AI Passport projects.
description.zh: 面向 FoloToy AI Passport 项目的非官方 DSH 智能体预设与 Windows 测试打包组件。

description.en: Acceptance-first workflow plugin that defines done criteria and verifies delivery with commands and exit codes before claiming completion.
description.zh: 这是一个验收优先的工作流插件，先定义完成标准，再用命令和退出码验证交付，确保无证据不得声称完成。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base panel that indexes Markdown rules, skills and plugin lists across agents on a focusable canvas with in-place file editing.
description.zh: 本地优先的知识库面板，将多个智能体的 Markdown 规则、技能与插件清单索引到可聚焦画布上，并支持就地编辑真实文件。

description.en: Live A-share sector and gold ticker docked in the DSH composer, showing daily and 1-minute moves with bold flash alerts.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框停靠栏中显示 A 股板块与黄金行情，提供日涨跌幅与 1 分钟变动，并在剧烈波动时加粗闪烁提醒。

description.en: PyPI workflow plugin: search packages and releases, verify names, publish distributions with a zero-dependency uploader, and track your own projects.
description.zh: PyPI 工作流插件：查询包与版本、校验包名、使用零依赖上传器发布分发包，并跟踪自己的项目列表。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin that streams downloads of host and dsh-remote SSH files, including large and unpreviewable files.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 插件，可流式下载本机及 dsh-remote SSH 远程文件，支持大文件与无法预览的文件。

description.en: Canvas design plugin that generates HTML prototypes, supports element annotation and revision, and exports designs into your project with responsive previews.
description.zh: 画布设计插件，一键生成 HTML 原型，选中元素即可批注返修，并可直接落地到项目，支持移动端、PC 端和网页端预览。

description.en: Local ComfyUI workbench for DSH with queue and progress monitoring, prompt editing, image library, workflow canvas and agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 ComfyUI 工作台，提供系统与队列状态、生成进度、提示词编辑、本地图片库、工作流画布和代理工具。

description.en: Automates screen-share quizzes: captures the window, OCR-reads questions, lets the model answer, clicks options and verifies each step until the last question.
description.zh: 自动化屏幕共享答题：截取窗口画面，用 Apple Vision OCR 识别题目，由模型给出答案并自动点击选项、逐题校验状态，直到最后一题停止。

description.en: A DSH coding-agent runtime that orchestrates tasks with a Pro planner and Flash sub-agents across Codex's five-stage contract.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 编程智能体运行时插件，用 Pro 分析需求编排任务、Flash 子智能体执行，并按五段式契约层层推进。

description.en: Delegates tasks asynchronously to external ACP agents like Codex, Claude Code and Gemini, with live child-session streaming and token accounting.
description.zh: 将任务异步委派给 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini 等外部 ACP 智能体,支持子会话实时流式输出与 token 统计。

description.en: Edit earlier user messages in the chat history and regenerate the reply within the same DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 在同一个 DeepSeek Harness 会话中编辑历史用户消息并重新生成回复。

description.en: Use a WallpaperMachine library as the DeepSeek Harness background on macOS, with live Scene wallpapers via WebWallGL plus video and image wallpapers.
description.zh: 在 macOS 上将 WallpaperMachine 壁纸库用作 DeepSeek Harness 背景，支持 WebWallGL 动态场景壁纸以及视频和图片壁纸。

description.en: Adds a "hard-task model" suggestion layer so the main session can pick stronger whitelisted models for DSH native subagents based on task difficulty.
description.zh: 为主会话选择 DSH 原生子智能体模型时增加「困难任务模型」建议，可按任务难度为子智能体选用更合适的白名单模型。

description.en: Batch export selected Sessions as restorable ZIP archives with logs, subagent sessions and attachments, then restore them on another machine along with plugin inventory.
description.zh: 批量导出所选会话为可恢复的 ZIP 归档（日志、子代理会话与附件），并可在另一台机器上恢复，同时迁移插件清单。

description.en: Adds AVIF, TIFF and SVG support to DSH read_image and the composer by automatically converting them to PNG.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 read_image 和输入框增加 AVIF、TIFF、SVG 支持，自动转换为 PNG。

description.en: Blueprint-driven white-box project board for DSH with live task status, progress rings and ETA, dependency DAG, critical path, burndown charts and code drill-down.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的蓝图驱动项目白盒看板，提供任务实时状态与 ETA、依赖 DAG、关键路径、燃尽图和代码下钻。

description.en: File-based experience cards that inject a one-line pointer (not the full card) when a matching tool error occurs, with hit stats, rarity, sync and a community library.
description.zh: 基于文件的经验卡片：当工具报错匹配时只注入一行卡片指引入口，附带命中统计、稀有度、跨机同步与社区库。

description.en: Idea-style sidebar that replaces the stock column with an activity rail, workspace file tree and a tabbed bottom terminal panel.
description.zh: Idea 风格侧边栏，用活动栏、工作区文件树和底部多标签终端面板取代原生侧边栏栏位。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin that replaces the Windows window title bar with an in-app bar carrying New Session and Session History actions.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 插件，用应用配色重绘 Windows 窗口标题栏，并加入新建会话与会话历史按钮。

description.en: Builds a bilateral research knowledge graph with multi-source scholarly search, bilingual summaries and mind maps inside DSH.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中构建双边科研知识图谱，支持多源学术检索、双语摘要与交互式思维导图。

description.en: Connects CNB (cnb.cool) to DeepSeek Harness: QR-code login, repo management, cloud dev environments, org usage and gateway model routing.
description.zh: 将 CNB（cnb.cool）接入 DeepSeek Harness：扫码登录、仓库管理、云原生开发环境、组织用量与网关模型路由。

description.en: Local book library plugin: agents can list, search, read by chapter and track progress, with a native reading panel in settings.
description.zh: 本地书库插件：agent 可查书、检索、按章读取并记录进度，设置内提供原生阅读面板。

description.en: Turns system audio and microphone input into real-time bilingual captions with translation and one-click meeting minutes.
description.zh: 将系统声音和麦克风输入转为实时双语字幕，支持翻译并一键生成会议纪要。

description.en: Publishes and updates GreasyFork userscripts: read versions, push new releases with changelogs, edit descriptions, search the site and check your account.
description.zh: 将用户脚本发布/更新到 GreasyFork：读取版本、带更新日志推送新版本、改简介、站内搜索与账号凭证管理。

description.en: Tracks DeepSeek Harness token usage and cost per workspace, model and channel, with a per-turn ledger and CSV/Excel export.
description.zh: 按工作区、模型和渠道统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量与费用，提供逐轮账本及 CSV/Excel 导出。

description.en: Stores Linux server credentials and runs SSH commands, environment checks and app management with a read-only overview and live terminal.
description.zh: 集中保管 Linux 服务器凭证，通过 SSH 执行命令、巡检环境和管理应用，并提供只读总览与实时彩色终端。

description.en: Shows your PlusVibeAPI balance under the chat input plus a spending card with today, month, per-chat totals and a daily chart.
description.zh: 在输入框下方显示 PlusVibeAPI 余额，并提供花费卡片：今日、本月、本聊天及每日图表。

description.en: Vocabulary review plugin that imports word-list photos via OCR, picks exam high-frequency words, and schedules spaced-repetition review with exports and reminders.
description.zh: 词汇复习插件：上传单词表或文章图片自动提取划线词与考点词，提供三档判定、间隔复习、薄弱词本导出、趋势诊断与到期提醒。

description.en: A Three-Body Problem universe atlas plugin with plot, 56-character relationship graph, era timeline, tech lore and a runnable gravity simulation.
description.zh: 三体宇宙图鉴插件：包含剧情、56位人物关系图谱、纪元时间线、技术造物，以及可运行的三体引力模拟。

description.en: Multi-machine DSH workbench: switch local/remote devices, cross-device Todo, 1–9 model quick-switch, mobile drawer and local Codex agent control.
description.zh: 多机 DSH 工作台：本机/远程设备切换、跨设备待办、1–9 模型快捷切换、移动端抽屉与本机 Codex Agent 控制入口。

description.en: Static Python architecture maps with drill-down from project to flow, module and method, exported as offline single-file HTML.
description.zh: 静态 Python 架构图，可从项目逐层下钻到流程、模块和方法，并导出为离线单文件 HTML。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns a solo AI chat into an AI dev team with a project manager who splits work, hires employees and reviews results.
description.zh: 一个把「单人跟 AI 聊天」升级为「带团队做事」的 DSH 插件，由项目经理拆活、招人并验收，员工各自拥有子工作区。

description.en: Two-step image studio: import a style reference, describe the scene, then generate structured JSON prompts and dual-model images in a workbench panel.
description.zh: 两步生图工作台：导入风格参考图并描述画面，即可生成结构化 JSON 提示词并用双模型出图。

description.en: Switches any existing DSH session to a different built-in agent mode on the fly, hot-swapping its toolset and system prompt without a new chat.
description.zh: 在任意现有 DSH 会话中即时切换到其他内置 Agent 模式，动态重组工具集与系统提示词，无需新建会话。

description.en: Adds a single download tool for DeepSeek Harness that auto-picks Motrix, direct, yt-dlp or Hugging Face as the engine and blocks stray curl -o writes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一下载工具，按目标自动选择 Motrix、直连、yt-dlp 或 Hugging Face 引擎，并拦截 curl -o 私自写盘。

description.en: Sidebar dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing peak/valley pricing, today's spend, tokens, budget runway and balance from local session logs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的侧栏用量仪表盘，基于本地会话日志展示峰谷时段、今日花费、tokens、预算可撑天数与余额。

description.en: Queues your composer draft and sends it automatically at a scheduled later time, such as off-peak cheap hours at 12:00 or 18:00.
description.zh: 将输入框草稿加入队列，在预约的稍后时间（如 12:00 / 18:00 错峰时段）自动发送。

description.en: Mobile-friendly DSH chat panel with its own searchable history library, image/PDF/Office attachments and an installable PWA page.
description.zh: 手机友好的 DSH 闲聊面板，自带可搜索的自管历史库，支持图片/PDF/Office 附件，并可安装为 PWA 独立网页应用。

description.en: DSH client plugin that connects to a local Breeze TTS service so the AI can speak aloud offline and clone voices, keeping data on-device.
description.zh: DSH 本地语音插件，连接自建的 Breeze TTS 服务，让 AI 离线开口朗读并克隆声音，数据不出本机。

description.en: Windows port management plugin that scans ports, maps them to processes, and guards them with rules so AI agents can control ports safely.
description.zh: Windows 端口管理插件，扫描端口并定位对应进程，配合规则保护与只读台账，让 AI 安全地操控端口。

description.en: Queues up to-dos during peak token-price hours and auto-dispatches them one by one to new or chosen DSH sessions during off-peak hours.
description.zh: 在峰价时段暂存待办，等进入谷价时段后自动逐条派发到新会话或指定会话执行。

description.en: Adds per-session status markers to the DSH sidebar, with a hover card for manual or AI-assigned statuses and a grouped cross-session overview panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏会话添加状态标记，悬停卡片可手动或由 AI 设置状态，并提供按状态分组的跨会话总览面板。

description.en: Pairs two independent DeepSeek Harness sessions (e.g. dev and review) and relays messages between them, queued, waking, or scheduled.
description.zh: 把两个独立的 DeepSeek Harness 会话（如开发与评审）配成一对，并在它们之间排队、唤醒或定时投递消息。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that drives a dedicated Chrome over CDP to collect Xiaohongshu note searches, details and comments, then drafts posts with the host LLM.
description.zh: DSH 桌面端小红书插件，通过 CDP 驱动专用 Chrome 采集笔记搜索、正文与评论，并用宿主 LLM 生成可发布笔记草稿。

description.en: Scrapes Toutiao's hot board and keyword search over plain HTTP, pulling full article text and generating semi-automatic publish drafts.
description.zh: 通过纯 HTTP 抓取今日头条热榜与关键词搜索，获取全文并生成半自动发布草稿。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that shows a draggable sub-agent summary in chat and a native sidebar tab with live status, tool state and final output.
description.zh: DSH 桌面插件：在聊天区显示可拖动的子智能体摘要，并在原生侧栏标签中查看实时状态、工具状态与最终输出。

description.en: Searchable library that keeps every file sent to DeepSeek Harness, with one-click filing and @library reuse.
description.zh: 可搜索的文件库，保存所有发送到 DeepSeek Harness 的文件，支持一键归档和 @library 复用。

description.en: Sidebar console for managing self-hosted cron-task panels (Qinglong 2.x and Daidai 3.x): connections, environment variables and scheduled jobs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏管理自托管定时任务面板（青龙 2.x 与呆呆 3.x）的控制台：面板连接、环境变量与定时任务。

description.en: Turns a PixelBar speaker into a real-time Agent status light, showing approval, running, error and done states via LED effects and a web console.
description.zh: 把花再 PixelBar 音箱变成 Agent 状态灯，用灯效与 LED 屏实时显示待审批、执行中、出错或完成状态，并提供 Web 控制台监控。

description.en: Adds a status badge that checks whether this machine's DSH is the latest release and, on request, installs the update and restarts itself.
description.zh: 在输入框下方加状态徽标，检查本机 DSH 是否为最新版本，并可按提示自动安装更新并重启。

description.en: Fetches real, context-aware reference images and embeds them in DSH replies as tables, collages, strips or durable attachments.
description.zh: 为 DSH 回复抓取真实的上下文相关参考图片，并以表格、拼图、多角度长图或持久附件形式嵌入。

description.en: Reuse prompts across conversations with a searchable palette, a draft optimizer, and a searchable prompt history sidebar.
description.zh: 跨会话复用提示词：可搜索面板、草稿优化器，以及可搜索的提示词历史侧边栏。

description.en: Command-palette style search for the current DSH chat session with instant hits, role filters, deep history paging and jump-to-message highlighting.
description.zh: 命令面板式的当前会话搜索插件：即时命中、高亮、按角色过滤，支持深度加载更早历史并跳转定位消息。

description.en: Windows DSH plugin that connects Feishu Doubao Work enterprise models with account management and usage history tracking.
description.zh: Windows DSH 插件，接入飞书豆包企业版模型，支持账号管理与使用历史记录。

description.en: Adds a Skills page to the DSH web client sidebar, listing every installed skill with a shared on/off switch.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页客户端左侧边栏新增「技能开关」页面，列出所有已安装技能并提供共享的开关。

description.en: Local plain-text double-entry Beancount ledger panel for DSH: the agent drafts entries, you approve or reject, and reconcile balances.
description.zh: DSH 中的本地纯文本复式 Beancount 账本面板：Agent 起草分录，你审批或驳回，并核对余额。

description.en: Developer utilities plugin for DeepSeek Harness with pinable sidebar tabs and built-in agent tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供开发者工具，包含可固定的侧边栏标签页与内置 agent 工具。

description.en: Headlessly generates KiCad/TSCircuit schematics and PCBs, auto-validates designs, and exports Gerber and STEP files in one click.
description.zh: 使用KiCad和TSCircuit无头绘制原理图与PCB，自动完成校验，并一键导出Gerber和STEP文件。

description.en: Turns scattered DSH sessions into a reviewable per-project stage chain with an issue archive, plus branch redo, session migration and backup/restore.
description.zh: 把 DSH 中散落各会话的项目进展归纳成可回看的阶段链与问题档案，并支持分支重做、会话迁移与备份恢复。

description.en: Right-side reading board that pins replies as Markdown and lets you quote selected passages back into the composer.
description.zh: 右侧阅读板：将回复固定为 Markdown，并可把选中片段引用回输入框。

description.en: Manages DSH skills: install from GitHub/skills.sh/local dirs, group them into packs, and toggle visibility per skill without editing skill files.
description.zh: 织音：从 GitHub、skills.sh 或本地目录安装技能，编成技能包并按需启停，决定模型可见范围，且不修改技能文件本身。

description.en: A global MCP server registry for DeepSeek Harness that lets agents lazily activate the right tool servers per folder.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的全局 MCP 服务器注册表，按文件夹由智能体惰性激活所需的工具服务器。

description.en: Local MCP bridge that lets Codex dispatch implementation tasks to native DeepSeek Harness sessions and read results in the same chat.
description.zh: 本地 MCP 桥接插件，让 Codex 把实现任务派发给 DSH 原生会话并在同一对话中取回结果。

description.en: Access DSH from your phone over a private device fabric with HITL approvals, file preview and out-of-band notifications.
description.zh: 通过私有设备网络在手机上远程操控 DSH，支持人工审批、文件预览与带外通知。

description.en: Adds a user-editable reporting layer so you choose which DSH agents and subagents report to whom, on top of the fixed native tree.
description.zh: 新增用户可编辑的汇报层级，让你自行决定 DSH 智能体与子智能体谁向谁汇报，叠加在固定的原生树之上。

description.en: DSH plugin that disables the developer role flag for Qwen/DashScope models to fix 400 errors while keeping reasoning on.
description.zh: DSH 插件通过关闭 Qwen/DashScope 模型的 developer 角色标记来修复 400 错误，同时保持推理功能开启。

description.en: DSH desktop plugin that replaces LLM summarisation with a dependency-free, millisecond structural context-compression engine, cutting redundant tokens without any model calls.
description.zh: DSH 桌面版插件，用无依赖、毫秒级的结构化上下文压缩引擎替代 LLM 摘要，在不调用模型的情况下清除冗余 token。

description.en: A joke plugin that intercepts every model call and replies with a fixed 'you saved tokens!' message, counting saved calls on a settings page.
description.zh: 一个整活插件：拦截每次模型调用并固定回复「恭喜你，又省下了 token！」，同时在设置页统计省下的调用次数。

description.en: Quote any text in chat to ask about it in place, with green-underline highlights, saved Q&A pairs and cross-session search.
description.zh: 在对话中引用任意文本就地提问，支持绿色下划线高亮、问答留存与跨会话搜索。

description.en: Reads each conversation turn as E/S/P emotion curves, classifies state shapes and remembers them under names you choose yourself.
description.zh: 把每轮对话读成 E/S/P 三条情绪曲线，先分状态形状，再按你自己起的名字归类并记忆。

description.en: Git-backed external memory brain that snapshots your AI's memory, persona, skills, session index and profile on shutdown and restores them on any machine.
description.zh: 基于 Git 的外置云脑：关机自动快照，开机自动还原，让记忆、人格、技能、会话索引与用户画像在任意机器上逐字节一致。

description.en: Adds an Overview tab to the conversation view showing turns, elapsed time and token usage stats.
description.zh: 为对话视图新增 Overview 标签页，展示轮次、耗时和 token 用量统计。

description.en: A DSH bundle adding three agent presets (software dev, game dev, read-only discussion), six bundled skills, and session-isolation toggles.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件包，提供三个 Agent 预设（软件开发、游戏开发、只读讨论）、六个内置技能，以及会话隔离开关。

description.en: Manages MCP servers inside DeepSeek Harness: view/enable them, import configs from other clients, search the registry, test connections and store secrets safely.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理 MCP 服务：查看与启停、从其他客户端导入配置、搜索官方注册表、验证连接，并把密钥安全存入凭证服务。

description.en: DSH plugin that gates which skills and MCP tools are exposed to the model per session or globally, with a sidebar checklist.
description.zh: 按会话或全局控制暴露给模型的 skill 与 MCP 工具的 DSH 插件，提供侧边栏勾选面板。

description.en: Two Evangelion-inspired palettes for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: graphite/red Asuka dark mode and porcelain/blue Rei light mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供两套福音战士主题配色：Asuka 石墨红暗色模式与 Rei 瓷白蓝亮色模式。

description.en: Adds encoding-adaptive file access to dsh: UTF-8/UTF-8 BOM passthrough, byte-exact round-trips for 16 legacy encodings, and encoding-aware grep.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供编码自适应文件访问：UTF-8/UTF-8 BOM 直通、16 种传统编码的字节级精确往返，以及感知编码的 grep。

description.en: Adds Reasonix-style two-level plan steps with a single sign-off path and a live plan panel to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Reasonix 风格的两级计划步骤、单一签核流程和实时计划面板。

description.en: View, search and edit all workspace and global AGENTS.md files in one panel, with templates, batch preview and AI edit suggestions.
description.zh: 在一个面板中查看、搜索和编辑工作区及全局 AGENTS.md，支持模板、批量预览和 AI 修改建议。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness skill that calls Alibaba Qwen Token Plan to generate and edit images and videos from any session.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 技能：调用阿里云百炼 Token Plan 在任意会话中生成与编辑图像和视频。

description.en: Adds a left-navigation entry and a right-sidebar panel that embeds chat.deepseek.com inside DeepSeek Harness, with configurable sidebar visibility.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中新增左侧导航入口和右侧边栏面板，内嵌 chat.deepseek.com，并可配置侧边栏显示。

description.en: Collects work scattered across multiple Git repos, branches and local docs and turns it into a ready-to-share daily report.
description.zh: 把散落在多个 Git 仓库、分支和本地文档里的工作自动汇总成一份可直接汇报的日报。

description.en: Adds Codex-style Fast Mode to DeepSeek Harness with per-session priority, honest A/B probing, and real TTFT metrics.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Codex 风格快速模式，支持按会话设置服务等级优先权、诚实的 A/B 探测以及真实 TTFT 指标。

description.en: DSH plugin that injects a docs convention, scaffolds a dsh docs/ directory, and validates document structure and links.
description.zh: DSH 插件：注入文档规范，生成 dsh docs/ 文档骨架，并校验文档结构与相对链接。

description.en: Guards PowerShell 5.1 commands run through ops_bash with UTF-16LE transfer, compatibility rewrites and normalized results.
description.zh: 为通过 ops_bash 调用的 PowerShell 5.1 命令提供 UTF-16LE 传输保护、兼容性改写与结果归一化。

description.en: A mock-interview room that turns your resume and a job JD into a prepared live interview with ASR transcription and local recording.
description.zh: 模拟面试间：把一份简历和一份岗位JD变成一场有准备的模拟面试，支持语音转录与本地录像。

description.en: Windows 10/11 desktop notifications for DSH approval requests, interruptions, questions and completed tasks, with click-to-return to the originating session.
description.zh: 为 Windows 10/11 提供 DSH 桌面通知，任务审批、中断、提问或完成时提醒，点击可返回对应会话。

description.en: Source-aware tool profile manager for DeepSeek Harness that groups tools by originating plugin, syncs PTC prompts and assigns tools with AI.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工具档位管理插件，按来源插件分组工具、同步 PTC 提示并由 AI 分配工具。

description.en: Windows DSH plugin that routes the bash tool through Git Bash and removes PowerShell from every agent's toolset.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH 插件，将 bash 工具交由 Git Bash 执行，并从所有 agent 中移除 PowerShell。

description.en: Adds a sidebar artifact manager to browse, search, preview and manage DSH-generated files across directories with card/list views.
description.zh: 在左侧栏新增产物管家，可跨目录浏览、搜索、预览并管理 DSH 生成的文件，支持卡片/列表双视图。

description.en: Reads PTT boards and comments through the public web version, writes local daily digests and collects style-reference sentences.
description.zh: 透过 PTT 公开网页版读取看板与推文，生成本机日报，并收集乡民用语样本。

description.en: Adds a WeChat-style group chat view where the user and several DSH sessions talk and discuss together in one shared room.
description.zh: 添加一个微信群风格的群聊视图，让用户与多个 DSH 会话在同一个房间里同时聊天、讨论。

description.en: Adds a settings-panel editor for the global /.dsh/AGENTS.md rules file with auto-backups, conflict detection and one-click restore.
description.zh: 在设置面板中新增全局规则 /.dsh/AGENTS.md 编辑器，支持自动备份、冲突检测与一键恢复。

description.en: A DSH skill plugin that turns building a web page into a four-step engineering flow (requirement, design, implementation, acceptance) with a 32-rule frontend spec checker and 68-entry component librar
description.zh: 一个把页面开发变成需求、设计、实现、验收四步流程的 DSH 技能插件，内置 32 条前端规范红线检查器和 68 个组件库选型目录。

description.en: Doubao desktop pet in the Web UI corner showing cost/quota bubbles, draggable and resizable, plus Doubao image generation via agent tools and Ark API.
description.zh: Web 界面角落的豆包桌宠，悬浮显示资费与额度气泡，可拖动缩放贴边，并通过 Agent 工具与方舟 API 生图。

description.en: Augments the DSH Web shell with a Running & recent panel, activity buckets and session artifacts so you see the working session, not just the answer.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面增加「运行中与最近」面板、活动分组和会话产物视图，让你看到工作过程而非只有答案。

description.en: A DSH better-sidebar plugin that lists Git merge conflicts and lets you view and resolve them inside the harness.
description.zh: 一个 DSH better-sidebar 插件，在侧边栏中列出 Git 合并冲突并支持查看与解决冲突。

description.en: DSH plugin that uses a decision model to analyze each request and auto-route it to the best-fitting model across multiple providers, with quota cooldown and silent fallback.
description.zh: DSH 插件：用决策模型分析每次请求，自动路由到最合适的模型，支持多厂商、额度冷却与静默回退。

description.en: Audits DeepSeek Harness sessions to measure reclaimable wait time and report the speedup percentage for each round.
description.zh: 审计 DeepSeek Harness 会话，统计可回收的等待时间并报告每轮的提速百分比。

description.en: Adds OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoints to DSH so any OpenAI client can use its local SenseVoice speech-to-text model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补出 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1/audio/transcriptions 接口，让任意 OpenAI 客户端调用内置 SenseVoice 语转文模型。

description.en: Persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with topic organization, undoable merges, native reminders, Markdown storage, import/export and backups.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久记忆的插件，支持主题整理、可撤销合并、原生提醒、Markdown 本地存储、导入导出与备份恢复。

description.en: DSH plugin that displays imported TXT/EPUB novels in the gaps between reasoning chunks, remembering reading progress at zero context cost.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在思维链分块间隙显示导入的 TXT/EPUB 小说，记忆阅读进度，且零上下文开销。

description.en: Updates a web-only DeepSeek Harness host from its web GUI on Windows with nightly builds, sha512-verified installers and automatic host restart.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上通过 Web 界面自更新 DeepSeek Harness 宿主：夜间构建源、sha512 校验安装包、独立安装并自动重启宿主。
