description.en: Adjustable sidebar typography for the dsh Workspace section: project rows bold, session rows smaller, with font family, size, weight and italic settings plus a Collapse all button.
description.zh: 为 dsh 侧边栏「工作区」提供可调字体排版：项目行加粗、会话行小一号，可在设置页分别调整字体、字号、加粗与斜体，并带「全部折叠」按钮。

description.en: Persists unsent DSH composer drafts on the Host instead of browser localStorage, surviving reloads, session switches and Host restarts across devices.
description.zh: 将未发送的 DSH 输入框草稿保存在 Host 而非浏览器 localStorage，可跨刷新、切会话、Host 重启及多设备保留。

description.en: Ships native role presets and one-click implementer/reviewer teams for DeepSeek Harness agent workflows.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生角色预设和一键式实现者/审查者团队。

description.en: Sidebar panel to discover, test and configure NVIDIA NIM models, save the API key, and fail over between models at runtime.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板，用于发现、试调用并配置 NVIDIA NIM 模型，保存 API Key，并在运行时自动切换可用模型。

description.en: Closes out a context stage before compaction and hands the next stage a reviewable markdown handoff file instead of a lossy summary.
description.zh: 在压缩前结束当前上下文阶段，并把可审阅的 markdown 交接文件交给下一阶段，而不是摘要。

description.en: Adds a /mcp panel to view MCP server connection status, import configurations and manage servers.
description.zh: 新增 /mcp 面板，可查看 MCP 服务器连接状态、导入配置并管理服务器。

description.en: Appends parent-workspace AGENTS.md guidance to sessions in nested git workspaces so child repos inherit upstream instructions.
description.zh: 为嵌套 Git 子工作区的会话追加父工作区 AGENTS.md 指导，让子仓库继承上级指令。

description.en: DSH host guardrail that blocks any foreground tool call likely to block for more than 60 seconds, with a once-per-turn manual override.
description.zh: DSH 前台守卫插件：拦截可能阻塞前台超过 60 秒的工具调用，每回合可手动授权一次。

description.en: Anime desktop-pet companion for DeepSeek Harness, adapting the edgerunners characters Roman, Talia, Di and Wick as decorative on-screen personas.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的动漫桌宠伴侣，将 edgerunners 角色 Roman、Talia、Di 和 Wick 作为装饰性形象呈现。

description.en: Adds a composer button that merges ordinary queued text messages in the current session into one queued message, never sending it.
description.zh: 在输入框旁添加按钮，把当前会话中排队的普通文本消息合并为一条仍处于队列中的消息，不会自动发送。

description.en: Organizational memory plugin that turns goals into task networks, records judgments and anti-patterns, and tracks measurable iteration loops.
description.zh: 组织记忆插件，可将目标拆解为任务网络，记录可验证判断与反模式，并跟踪可度量的迭代循环。

description.en: Voice-first macOS assistant that recalls recently viewed documents and web pages from local 7-day clues and opens them on request.
description.zh: 语音优先的 macOS 资料助手：根据本地 7 天线索找回最近看过的文档与网页，并按需打开。

description.en: Connects Super Agent group chat and discussion into dsh via a cordis plugin with 5 agent tools, an agent-chat skill and a reusable workbench UI over the /wb channel.
description.zh: 通过 cordis 插件把 Super Agent 群聊与讨论接入 dsh，提供 5 个 agent 工具、agent-chat 技能，并经 /wb 通道复用完整工作台界面。

description.en: A Splatoon-inspired visual theme (SPLAT STREET) that reskins the DeepSeek Harness interface with custom colors and styling.
description.zh: 一款斯普拉遁风格的 SPLAT STREET 主题，为 DeepSeek Harness 界面提供配色与外观皮肤。

description.en: Local RSS, webpage and GitHub Releases subscription hub with a three-pane panel that pipes selected items into chat drafts and model context.
description.zh: 本地 RSS、网页与 GitHub Releases 订阅中心，三栏面板可将选中条目写入对话草稿并上报给模型。

description.en: Adds color tags to DSH sessions and workspaces via context menu, colored titles, a sidebar filter bar and 8 UI languages.
description.zh: 通过右键菜单为 DSH 会话和工作区添加彩色标签，支持彩色标题、侧边栏筛选栏以及 8 种界面语言。

description.en: Godot 4 production pack for DSH with runnable 2D templates, a deterministic scene/script validator, and one-command Web export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Godot 4 生产工具包，提供可运行的 2D 模板、确定性的场景/脚本校验器以及一键 Web 导出。

description.en: DSH appearance theme plugin: custom image/video wallpapers with crop, blur, glass cards, wallpaper colour extraction and a sidebar balance/token widget.
description.zh: DSH 外观主题插件：支持图片/视频整窗壁纸、裁切模糊、玻璃卡片、壁纸取色主题，以及侧栏余额与今日 token 小组件。

description.en: Shows an unread-count badge on the Windows taskbar icon and plays a chime when a DSH session turn completes.
description.zh: DSH 会话回合完成时，在 Windows 任务栏图标上显示未读数徽标并播放提示音。

description.en: A local mistake ledger that turns agent errors into a structured pitfall library and auto-retrieves relevant lessons before similar tasks.
description.zh: 一个本地错题本，把 Agent 犯过的错结构化沉淀为坑库，并在同类任务开始前自动检索相关经验。

description.en: Scientific agent skill pack for literature reading, academic writing, scientific figures and presentation generation.
description.zh: 科研智能体技能包：文献阅读、学术写作、科研图表与演示文稿生成。

description.en: Adds a composer toolbar menu that turns individual tools and skills on or off per session, grouped by plugin.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏提供按插件分组的开关，可为每个会话单独开启或关闭各个工具与技能。

description.en: Adds vendor avatars to the session header that slide out each provider's own web chat (DeepSeek, Doubao, Gemini) in a side panel.
description.zh: 在会话头部增加一排厂家头像，点击即从右侧滑出 DeepSeek / 豆包 / Gemini 官方网页聊天，主界面收窄让位。

description.en: Splits a local video into hardcoded subtitles, shots and storyboard descriptions, then lets the session model assemble the full plot.
description.zh: 把本地视频拆成硬字幕、镜头和分镜描述，再由会话中的模型拼成完整剧情。

description.en: A BornCode plugin bundle for DSH adding agent customization, desktop control, browser use, session sync, auto-continue/shutdown and side chat.
description.zh: 一个 BornCode 插件合集，为 DSH 提供代理定制、桌面控制、浏览器使用、会话同步、自动继续/关机和侧边聊天。

description.en: Packages local DSH plugins into portable ZIPs and installs or updates them offline on other machines via a standalone script.
description.zh: 将本地 DSH 插件打包为便携 ZIP，并通过独立脚本在其他机器上离线安装或更新。

description.en: Prints daily, weekly, monthly, 30/90-day or all-time token usage and estimated model costs as a receipt, with clipboard copy and PNG export.
description.zh: 按日、周、月、30天、90天或全部时间生成 token 用量与预估模型费用的收据，支持复制到剪贴板和导出 PNG。

description.en: An AI-native desktop OS you assemble yourself: describe an app in one sentence and get it, with every app leaving as a portable file.
description.zh: 一个可自行组装的AI原生桌面操作系统：说一句话就能生成应用，每个应用都能以文件形式带走。

description.en: Sends email through the Mailgun HTTP API with per-message open and click tracking, and reads delivery and engagement events.
description.zh: 通过 Mailgun HTTP API 发送邮件，支持按邮件开启打开与点击跟踪，并可读取投递和互动事件。

description.en: Registers a 'search files' model tool in DSH that finds file names and paths on Windows via the Everything es.exe CLI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 search files 模型工具，在 Windows 上通过 Everything 的 es.exe 命令行快速搜索文件名与路径。

description.en: Manage local and multiple SSH-device sessions from a DeepSeek Harness sidebar, grouped and resumable in the main area.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏统一管理本机与多台 SSH 设备的会话，分组展示并可继续远程会话。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a Codex model row, calling the Codex /responses endpoint directly with the local Codex CLI OAuth credentials.
description.zh: DSH 插件，新增 Codex 模型选项，直接调用 Codex /responses 接口并复用本地 Codex CLI 的 OAuth 凭证。

description.en: DSH plugin dashboard that lists every installed plugin in one screen, toggles each on/off, and hot-swaps updates without a restart.
description.zh: DSH 插件管理台：一屏列出全部插件，一键开关，更新后自动热替换、无需重启。

description.en: Adds a One Piece-themed status widget to the DSH web UI showing your account balance, forked from MeteorNOX's whale widget.
description.zh: 为 DSH 网页界面添加一个海贼王主题的状态小部件，用于显示账户余额，基于 MeteorNOX 的鲸鱼小部件二次开发。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a NovaFlow account, native models, media MCP tools and a user-confirmed plugin setup flow.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 NovaFlow 账号、原生模型、媒体 MCP 工具和需用户确认的插件安装流程。

description.en: Lets two existing DSH sessions automatically talk to each other for a set number of turns at a fixed daily time, re-injecting the same rules each turn.
description.zh: 让两个已存在的 DSH 会话在每天固定时间按规则自动对话若干轮，每一句都附带同一份规则。

description.en: Exports allowlisted Telegram group chats with human-only consent, verbatim notices and local-model digests into local archives.
description.zh: 通过仅限人工的同意、原文提示和本地模型摘要，将白名单内的 Telegram 群聊导出为本地存档。

description.en: Adds a Search provider settings card to the Plugins page so users can switch dsh web search between DeepSeek and Exa instantly.
description.zh: 在插件页添加“搜索提供商”设置卡片，可即时在 DeepSeek 与 Exa 之间切换 dsh 的网页搜索源。

description.en: A DSH Web UI decoration plugin that fires emoji confetti and a spinning disco mirror ball when the agent is told to celebrate.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web UI 装饰插件，让智能体「放礼炮」时屏幕喷出 emoji 彩纸，并降下旋转的迪斯科镜面球。

description.en: Adds a live headless Chrome/Edge browser panel in the dsh right sidebar that both the human and the agent can control.
description.zh: 在 dsh 右侧边栏加入一个由真实无头 Chrome/Edge 驱动的实时浏览器面板，人和智能体可同时操作。

description.en: Toggle each agent skill on, user-only, or off from the composer and Settings, updating SKILL.md invocation fields.
description.zh: 在输入框弹层与设置页中，将每个 agent 技能切换为开启、仅用户可用或关闭，并写入 SKILL.md 调用字段。

description.en: Prompt-routed subagent delegation from DeepSeek Harness to DSH, Codex, Kimi Code and Antigravity (agy) agents.
description.zh: 通过提示词路由，将 DeepSeek Harness 的任务委派给 DSH、Codex、Kimi Code 和 Antigravity（agy）子代理。

description.en: Uses your Claude Code (Claude Pro/Max) sign-in as a DSH model provider, keeping the pi-ai credential synced with the Claude Code keychain.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code(Claude Pro/Max)的登录凭据用作 DSH 模型提供方,并让 pi-ai 凭据与 Claude Code 钥匙串保持同步。

description.en: DSH plugin that lists local TCP listening ports with their owning processes and safely kills them after re-verifying process identity to avoid PID-reuse mistakes.
description.zh: DSH 插件：列出本机 TCP 监听端口及占用进程，结束前复核进程身份，避免误杀被复用的 PID。

description.en: Dual-role DSH plugin that pairs devices via QR or short code and lets one DSH host securely operate another with per-device tokens.
description.zh: 双角色 DSH 远程访问插件，通过二维码或短码配对设备，让一个 DSH 主机凭每设备令牌安全操作另一个主机。

description.en: Self-hosted, project-scoped long-term memory for DSH that avoids running an LLM on every write.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的自托管项目级长期记忆，写入路径无需调用大模型，低成本高效。

description.en: Sidebar kanban panel plus 10 model tools that connect DeepSeek Harness to a Dutang council execution server for agents, issues, cases and artifacts.
description.zh: 侧栏看板面板与 10 个模型工具，把 DeepSeek Harness 接入都堂三省六部可信执行台，管理 Agent、Issue、案卷与成物。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns agent modes into full presets, each with its own persona, tool set and plugin mounts, shipping six ready-made modes.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将代理模式变成完整预设，每种模式自带人格、工具集和插件挂载，并内置六种模式。

description.en: Third-party workflow library for DSH that lets you review, save, parameterize and reuse successful task workflows.
description.zh: DSH 的第三方工作流库，可回顾、保存、参数化并复用成功的任务工作流。

description.en: Ask once and query multiple OpenAI-compatible models in parallel, auto-save each Q&A group locally, and like answers with model rating analytics.
description.zh: 一次提问并发调用多个 OpenAI 兼容模型，每组问答自动保存到本地，并可对回答点赞与查看模型点赞统计。

description.en: A resident AI commander plugin for DeepSeek Harness that makes routine decisions for you and delegates work through tiered automation levels.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的常驻 AI 指挥员插件，替你做常规决策，并通过分级方式托管不同层级的自动化任务。

description.en: Shipping-schedule data workbench: WeChat article collection, AI hotspot digests, old-vs-new schedule diffing with AI review, and route plausibility checks.
description.zh: 船期数据工作台：公众号采集、AI 热点摘要、船期新旧对比与 AI 复核、轨迹合理性检测。

description.en: A DSH settings workbench that turns a model ID into a correct, explainable model entry with previewed, version-fenced writes.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 设置工作台，把模型 ID 变成正确可解释的模型条目，写入前预览并带版本围栏。

description.en: A collection of installable DSH plugins (friendly-expression, Feed Ultra and more) that can be installed individually or all at once via npm, GitHub or a local directory.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件合集（友好表达、Feed Ultra 等），支持通过 npm、GitHub 或本地目录单独安装或一次性全部安装。

description.en: Bundles 45 production-grade engineering skills and 11 callable lifecycle tools to give AI coding agents structured workflows.
description.zh: 为AI编码代理提供45项生产级工程技能和11个可调用的生命周期工具，构建结构化工作流。

description.en: Drafts tender and bid documents with 32 tools, code-enforced compliance checks, an offline Chinese policy library and .docx export.
description.zh: 招标与投标文件起草引擎：32个工具、代码级合规校验、离线中文政策库及.docx导出。

description.en: Portable Roblox development preset for DeepSeek Harness with native workers, role-aware routing and upstream Roblox skills.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的便携式 Roblox 开发预设，提供原生 worker、角色感知路由和上游 Roblox 技能。

description.en: Read-only connector that pulls EU product compliance evidence into DeepSeek Harness for review.
description.zh: 只读的欧盟产品合规证据连接器，将合规证据接入 DeepSeek Harness 供审阅。

description.en: Local-first AI livestream console that runs characters, answers Douyin chat and gifts, and governs memory, skills and training.
description.zh: 本地优先的 AI 直播控制台：管理角色、接收抖音互动并生成播出回复，同时治理记忆、技能与训练。

description.en: ComfyUI-style node canvas for building image and video generation workflows inside the DSH Web GUI, with AI auto-assembly and cloud or local ComfyUI backends.
description.zh: 仿 ComfyUI 的节点式画布，在 DSH Web GUI 中搭建图像/视频生成工作流，支持 AI 自动组建，默认云端模型、可选本地 ComfyUI。

description.en: Adds a sidebar indicator showing whether DeepSeek off-peak token pricing is active, checked against the official pricing page on every launch.
description.zh: 在侧边栏显示 DeepSeek 错峰时段 token 优惠是否生效，每次启动时都会对照官方定价页面进行校验。

description.en: Local-first AI research workbench for managing papers, reading PDFs, annotating them, and linking notes to source-grounded AI conversations.
description.zh: 本地优先的 AI 科研工作台，支持论文管理、PDF 精读批注、并排笔记与带来源引用的 AI 对话。

description.en: A beta context-folding plugin for the DeepSeek harness that compacts long sessions to reduce window pressure and token usage.
description.zh: 一个测试中的上下文折叠插件，用于 DeepSeek harness，通过压缩长会话降低窗口压力和 token 消耗。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns your Obsidian markdown vaults into shared memory and knowledge for agents.
description.zh: 一款 DeepSeek Harness 插件，可将 Obsidian Markdown 知识库用作智能体的共享记忆与知识来源。

description.en: Live, zoomable map showing each model call, its response, and which subagent gets dispatched in DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 实时可缩放地图，展示 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的每次模型调用、返回结果及分派的子代理。

description.en: A dreamy pink fish desktop pet for the DSH Web UI that shows all live sessions at a glance and lets you approve requests in place.
description.zh: 一只梦幻粉色小鱼桌宠，作为 DSH Web UI 的虚拟形象入口，同屏展示多会话状态并就地完成审批。

description.en: Hash-chained, append-only evidence ledger from dsh-super-agent that records agent activity inside DeepSeek Harness and makes tampering detectable.
description.zh: 来自 dsh-super-agent 的哈希链式只追加证据账本，在 DeepSeek Harness 中记录并防篡改校验。

description.en: DSH plugin that subscribes to the session event stream and appends one diary entry per settled turn into a git repo you own.
description.zh: DSH 插件订阅会话事件流，将每个完成回合追加为一条日记条目，写入属于你自己的 git 仓库。

description.en: Manages local DSH agent KV cache lifecycle, cleans stale session directories with a recycle bin, and stores reusable persona/project conventions.
description.zh: 管理本地 DSH Agent 的 KV cache 生命周期，清理会话目录并支持回收站，同时保存可复用的称呼与项目约定。

description.en: A local-first writing workspace for novels and screenplays, with a story bible, evidence-based manuscript diagnosis, AI collaboration, and version-safe revision.
description.zh: 一个本地优先的小说与剧本创作工作台，提供故事圣经、基于证据的诊断、AI 协作以及安全版本修订。

description.en: Embeds the acgay.cn music site in a DSH side drawer with persistent login, parallel search and track import.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧抽屉中嵌入 acgay.cn 音乐站点，支持登录保持、并行搜索与歌曲导入。

description.en: Adds a Run button to the DSH session header that launches the project's start script in a new console window, bound via .dsh/run button.json.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话标题栏添加“运行按钮”，一键在新控制台窗口中启动项目启动脚本，脚本路径由 .dsh/run button.json 绑定。

description.en: Folds finished tool outputs and reasoning at phase boundaries into spill files, keeping only conclusions in the context window to cut token cost.
description.zh: 在阶段边界把已出结果、不再需要全文的工具输出与思考过程折叠起来，结论留在上下文窗口，原文落盘可随时取回，降低长会话的 token 成本。

description.en: Pins every subagent to a single chosen model and aborts on drift, so an expensive parent model can't drain your quota.
description.zh: 将所有子代理固定到同一个指定模型，一旦发生模型漂移立即中止，避免昂贵的父模型耗尽额度。

description.en: Manage multiple OpenAI-compatible image generation configs and create or edit images directly inside the DSH conversation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理多套 OpenAI 兼容的生图配置，并在对话里直接文生图或按参考图编辑出图。

description.en: Adds a checklist panel and YAML-based per-workspace skill scoping, enforced across presets and existing sessions.
description.zh: 通过清单面板和 YAML 配置按工作区控制技能可见性，并对所有预设及现有会话生效。

description.en: Gives agents real Windows desktop input: eased mouse movement, clicks, drags, per-character typing, plus grid-overlay screenshots to verify results.
description.zh: 为智能体提供真实的 Windows 桌面输入能力：带缓动与抖动的鼠标移动、点击、拖拽、逐字输入，并用网格叠加截图验证结果。

description.en: Investment research dashboard for DeepSeek Harness covering memory, AI infrastructure, PCB/CCL and US data-center policy, with MCP market data and updateable research.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的投资研究看板，覆盖存储、AI 基础设施、PCB/CCL 与美国数据中心政策，并接入 MCP 行情数据、支持研究内容更新。

description.en: Auto-retries DSH model requests that fail on transient relay-gateway errors (5xx, rate limits, stream truncation) using exponential backoff.
description.zh: 当 DSH 模型请求因中继网关瞬时故障（5xx、限流、流截断）失败时，自动以指数退避方式重试。

description.en: Checks GitHub for compatible updates to installed DSH plugins and installs them one by one or in bulk, with progress and restart prompts.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的已安装插件列表中检查 GitHub 上的兼容更新，可逐个或批量安装，并显示进度与重启提示。

description.en: A standalone liquid-glass theme for DSH Web that adds a settings page to tune glass tint, blur, opacity and corner radius.
description.zh: DSH Web 的独立液态玻璃主题，在设置页可即时调节玻璃釉色、雾化、透明度与圆角。

description.en: A DSH theme plugin offering eight monochrome color palettes with matching accent colors, reasoning-meter tints and chat avatars via official dsw tokens.
description.zh: DSH 主题插件，提供八套单色相配色，强调色、推理等级条与对话头像随之切换，通过官方 dsw token 注入。

description.en: SCP upload and download tools for DeepSeek Harness that transfer files over the ssh2 legacy SCP wire protocol, no remote SFTP subsystem needed.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SCP 上传与下载工具，基于 ssh2 的旧版 SCP 协议传输文件，无需远端 SFTP 子系统。

description.en: Adds collapsible manual virtual groups to the DSH sidebar workspace list, changing only display grouping and order.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏工作区列表添加可折叠的手动虚拟分组，只改变显示归属与顺序。

description.en: Adds an explore-style card tree to the DSH Web UI so conversation branches grow into an editable graph with one-way references.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 加入探索式卡片树，让对话分支长成可编辑的图谱，并支持单向引用。

description.en: Scoped secret variables for DeepSeek Harness that stay out of prompts and logs, injected only as $DSH_SECRET_* in shell commands.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供作用域密钥变量，避免进入提示词与日志，仅在 shell 中以 $DSH_SECRET_* 形式注入使用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin for quota-aware recovery and task scheduling, requiring CLIProxyAPI and the cpa-quota-api-extension.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于配额感知恢复与任务调度，需配合 CLIProxyAPI 和 cpa-quota-api-extension 使用。

description.en: Collects each machine's dsh bridge public tunnel address into one secret Gist and refreshes online status every 4 hours.
description.zh: 把每台机器 dsh bridge 的公网隧道地址汇总到一个 secret Gist，每 4 小时整点刷新在线状态。

description.en: Adds a grouped workspace/project/session sidebar to the DSH web client plus a built-in remote SSH settings page.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 客户端提供分组工作区/项目/会话侧栏，并内置远程 SSH 设置页。

description.en: Left-sidebar live streaming console for DeepSeek Harness with persona scripts, stream logs, Bilibili danmaku, edge-tts speech and a memory inbox.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的左侧栏直播控制台，支持人设脚本、直播日志、B站弹幕、edge-tts 语音与记忆收件箱。

description.en: DSH plugin connecting a XiaoZhi ESP32-S3 voice terminal to a multi-platform AI companion with GPT-SoVITS voice cloning and ASR/TTS.
description.zh: DSH 插件：连接小智 ESP32-S3 语音终端，提供 B站/QQ/微信/抖音多平台 AI 陪伴角色，并支持 GPT-SoVITS 语音克隆与火山引擎 ASR/TTS。

description.en: Adds ghost-text next-message suggestions to the DSH composer; Tab accepts and Esc dismisses, with nothing ever auto-sent.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添加幽灵文本下一条消息建议，按 Tab 接受，按 Esc 关闭，绝不自动发送。

description.en: Adds four tools that let separate DSH sessions message each other, hand off tasks, reply back, and check progress, including auto-waking a closed session.
description.zh: 提供四个工具，让不同 DSH 会话之间互发消息、交接任务、回信并查看进度，还能自动唤醒已关闭的会话。

description.en: Academic paper workbench with a PDF library, bilingual reading, translation and built-in Agent sessions.
description.zh: 学术论文工作台，提供 PDF 文库、双语阅读、翻译和内置 Agent 会话。

description.en: Adds wake rules to any DSH session: the host periodically checks whether a turn ended abnormally and re-prompts the session to keep working.
description.zh: 给任意 DSH 会话挂唤醒规则：宿主定期检查该轮是否异常结束，命中条件就重新 prompt 让它继续干活。
